blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Engineers who audit a declared specification of an engineered system need to know which physical constraints it respects, which it violates, which field was altered and how to correct it. NeSySpec is an integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework, built on Logic Tensor Networks, that answers these questions in one pipeline. Its axioms encode the physical relations of the domain as differentiable graded predicates whose tolerances are learned from a fleet of real records; from the same degrees, it diagnoses the violated constraint, identifies the altered field by abduction, proposes a minimum-change correction and ties image evidence to the parts it describes, abstaining exactly where evidence is missing, and returns all of it in one verification report. We validate NeSySpec on 107 aircraft types, with 16 test aircraft of 9 families held out of training, on specification records paired with ground photographs and satellite imagery and on synthetic errors: generated corruptions, edits labeled from the edit alone and deliberate falsifications. NeSySpec combines all the assessed audit outputs in one pipeline, which no learned, rule-based, solver-based, neuro-symbolic or language-model comparator does; on the test aircraft none is ahead of it in the macro-F1 of its constraint verdicts, in naming the violated constraint and the altered field or in the repair error, and it is competitive in record and image-pair detection. Its diagnosis names the violated constraint in 94.2% of corrupted test records, against 79.5% for classical Fellegi-Holt diagnosis, and on edits labeled from the edit alone, without retraining, abduction finds the altered field in 59.3% of records, against 30.6% for minimum-cardinality localization with random tie- breaking. Only the knowledge base, the visual predicates, the corruption generator and the data are specific to the domain.
blocks.zh: 审计已申报的工程系统规格的工程师需要知道它尊重哪些物理限制、它违反了哪些限制、哪些领域被改变以及如何纠正限制。 NeSySpec是一个综合而可解释的神经-连锁审计框架,以Logic Tensor Networks为基础,在一个管道中解答这些问题. 它的轴线将域的物理关系编码为不同分级的上游,其耐受性从一大批真实记录中汲取;从同样程度,它诊断出被违反的制约,识别被劫持而改变的域,提出最小变化的校正,将图像证据与它描述的部分联系起来,放弃确切的证据缺失之处,并在一份核查报告中将其全部还原. 我们验证了107种飞机的NeSySpec,对9个家庭的16架试验飞机进行了培训,并验证了与地面照片和卫星图像配对的规格记录以及合成错误:产生了腐败,编辑后只加了标签,并故意作假。 NeSySpec将所有评估的审计产出合并在一个管道中,没有学习的,基于规则的,基于解析器的,基于神经同位素的或语言模型的参照物的;在测试飞机上,在其约束判决的宏观-F1中,在指定被违反的制约和被改变的场或修复出错时,没有一个比它更领先,在记录和图像辅助检测上是竞争性的. 它的诊断将94.2%的腐败测试记录中的违规约束命名为"被违反约束",而古典的Fellegi-Holt诊断为79.5%,在仅从编辑中标注的编辑上,不进行再培训,绑架在59.3%的记录中发现了被改变的领域,而以随机打结方式进行最小心律局部化的为30.6%. 只有知识库,视觉上游,腐败发生器和数据是域所特有的.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Certification, maintenance and procurement engineers work with engineered systems they did not design and reverse-engineer them from declared specifications of masses, dimensions, ratings and performance.
A record can be incomplete, inconsistent, valid for another variant or misreported, and public knowledge bases hold wrong numerical values [ 1 ] ; the errors of a record propagate into the performance models it feeds [ 2 ] .
Auditing such records falls within the scope of civil technical intelligence, which gathers and assesses information about technologies and technical products [ 3 , 4 ] . Technical intelligence increasingly draws on open sources [ 5 , 6 ] . For aircraft, photographs and satellite imagery can also help verify the visually observable attributes reported in the specifications [ 7 , 8 ] .
We use reverse engineering in a first-approach sense: inferring which physical relations a declared specification and, when available, its image respect or violate, which field departs from them and which value restores them.
Table 1 lists the acronyms.
blocks.zh:
认证、维修和采购工程师使用所设计的系统,他们没有按照所申报的质量、尺寸、评级和性能的规格进行设计和逆向设计。
记录可能不完整、不一致、对另一种变体有效或报告错误,公共知识库持有错误的数字值[1];记录错误传播到它输入的性能模型[2]。
此类记录的审计属于民事技术情报的范围,民事技术情报收集和评估有关技术和技术产品的信息[3、4]。 技术情报越来越多地利用公开来源[5,6]. 对于飞机,照片和卫星图像还有助于核实规格[7、8]中报告的可见属性。
我们首先使用反向工程:推断哪些物理关系是已宣布的规格,如果有,则推断其图像尊重或违反,哪些字段偏离它们,哪些价值恢复它们。
表1列出了缩略语。

blocks.en:
Learned methods, from anomaly detectors to tabular foundation models and language models, score each record [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] , with field-level attributions [ 12 ] . Statistical data editing and consistency-based diagnosis identify violated constraints and the fields implicated in those violations, based on bounds set by experts [ 13 , 14 ] .
Neuro-Symbolic Artificial Intelligence (NeSy) integrates learning with explicit knowledge and reasoning [ 15 , 16 ] , also surveyed for advanced air mobility [ 17 ] , and can learn such bounds from data together with the constraints they delimit. To our knowledge, no previous work provides and evaluates together the outputs that such an audit needs, from the violated constraint and the altered field to part-grounded image evidence and a report (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
学到的方法,从异常探测器到表格式基础模型和语言模型,每张记录[9,10,11]得分,场级归属[12]. 统计数据编辑和基于一致性的诊断,根据专家确定的界限,查明违反限制的情况和与这些侵权行为有关的领域[13、14]。
Neuro-Symbolical人工智能(NeSy)将学习与明确的知识和推理[15,16]整合在一起,同时也接受高级空中机动性调查[17],并且可以从数据中学习这种界限以及它们所划定的限制. 据我们所知,以前的工作没有提供和评价这种审计所需的产出,从违反的制约和被改变的领域到部分根据的图像证据和报告(表2)。

blocks.en:
We present NeSySpec, an integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic framework for auditing engineering specifications, built on Logic Tensor Networks (LTN) [ 19 ] : trained on fleet data, it determines through its logical axioms which physical constraints a declared record respects and which it violates, and returns a verification report (Figures 1 and 5 ). Its graded predicates measure each physical, definitional or regulatory relation by its residual against bands learned from the training fleet, and cross-modal axioms compare the fields with what a vision module reads.
Masked quantification gives NeSySpec exact abstention on missing evidence: each verdict reduces to the constraints that the available evidence makes checkable, and the report lists every undeclared field with the constraints it leaves unchecked. The audit proceeds from detection to diagnosis and repair. It first scores the record using a masked mean of constraint violation degrees. This overall verdict can then be traced back to individual constraints, with the largest violation degree identifying the most violated constraint. An abductive search over single-field changes then localizes the altered field. Finally, a minimum-change repair searches for the smallest adjustment that restores coherence. A grounding axiom encourages each visual head to place its class-activation evidence on the part its predicate describes, so that the report ties image evidence to parts.
blocks.zh:
我们提出NeSySpec,这是一个用于审计工程规格的综合和可解释的神经系统框架,它建立在Logic Tensor Networks(LTN)[19] 上:关于车队数据的培训,它通过其逻辑定理确定哪些物理限制所宣布的记录尊重,哪些违反,并返回一份核查报告(图1和图5)。 其分级的上游参照从培训船队学到的波段,通过剩余波段衡量每个物理、定义或监管关系,跨模式轴线将字段与视觉模块的读物进行比较。
假说量化使得NeSySpec对缺失的证据投了确切的弃权票:每个判决都减轻了现有证据可以核查的限制,报告列举了每个未申报的领域,并列举了它所留下的限制。 审计从发现到诊断和修复。 它首先用一个隐蔽的强制度来评分记录。 然后,这一总体判决可以追溯到个人的制约,最大的违反程度是查明最违反的制约。 对单字段变化进行绑架性搜索,然后将改变的字段本地化。 最后,对恢复一致性的最小调整进行最小变化的修复搜索. 一个搁浅的轴线鼓励每个视觉头将其类活性证据放在其上游描述的部分,从而使报告将图像证据与部分联系起来.

blocks.en: We validate NeSySpec on 107 aircraft, with specification records, FGVC-Aircraft photographs [ 7 ] and RarePlanes satellite imagery [ 8 ] , holding 16 test aircraft of 9 families out of training, and evaluate constraint verdicts and diagnosis, field localization and repair, record coherence, missing evidence and absent images, the grounding of the visual axioms and robustness to deliberate falsification, on errors labeled by the corruption generator and on errors labeled from the edit alone (Section 4 ). The constraint verdicts reach a macro-F1 of 0.795 on generator labels and, without retraining, 0.575 on intervention labels, above a network trained with the DL2 loss on the same residuals and targets, the like-for-like neuro-symbolic test, and find every labeled violation in 0.934 of generator-labeled test corruptions against 0.522 for that network, with micro precision on par on test and lower on the unseen class (Section 4.2 , Appendix ). The largest-violation key identifies the violated constraint in 0.942 of generator-labeled test corruptions, outperforming Fellegi–Holt, solver-based and rule-based diagnosis, DL2 applied to the declared fields, and a prompted language model. Abduction then traces the error to an individual field, correctly identifying the altered field in 0.593 of independently labeled errors. By comparison, minimum-cardinality localization reaches 0.306 with random tie-breaking and 0.453 with oracle tie-breaking; a sizing-regression residual also reaches 0.453 (Figure 6 ). The record verdict detects incoherent records at a test AUROC of 0.979 on generator labels, and on satellite pairs the multimodal verifier, which names the contradicted axiom, detects incoherent record-image pairs at 0.994 over all pair types, against 0.748 for a prompted vision-language model (Section 4.4 ). Table 5 lines these results up. No comparator returns every output of the audit, and on the test aircraft no comparator is ahead of NeSySpec in the macro-F1 of the constraint verdicts, in naming the violated constraint and the altered field or in the repair error on the altered field; in record and pair detection, learners on the residuals and late fusions are close to it and in some settings rank higher (Section 4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们验证了107架飞机上的NeSySpec,并附有规格记录、FGVC-Aircraft照片[7]和RarePlanes卫星图像[8],持有16架9个家庭的试飞飞机,没有经过培训,并评估约束性判决和诊断、实地本地化和维修、记录一致性、缺失证据和缺失图像、视觉动因的落地和故意伪造的强烈性、腐败发生者贴上标签的错误以及仅从编辑中贴上标签的错误(第4节)。 限制判决在发电机标签上达到0.795的宏F1, 在没有再培训的情况下,在干预标签上达到0.575的宏F1, 在经过DL2损失培训的网络上,在同一残留物和目标上,在类似神经系统测试上,在0.934的发电机标签测试腐败中,在0.522的网络上,发现每个标签上的违规行为,在测试时均具有微精度,在看不见的类别上较低(第4.2节,附录)。 最大违规键可以识别0.942中违反限制的生成器标签测试腐败,表现优于Fellegi-Holt,基于解析器和基于规则的诊断,DL2适用于已宣布的字段,以及一个激发语言模型. 然后将误差追溯到单个字段,正确识别在独立标注误差的0.593中更改的字段. 相比之下,最小心力局部化达到0.306,随机断结,0.453,甲骨文断结;分量递减残基也达到0.453(图6). 记录裁定在对发电机标签的AUROC为0.979的测试中检测到不一致的记录,在卫星上检测到多模式验证器,该验证器将相互矛盾的轴标命名为0.994,在所有对型中检测到不一致的记录-图像对,而激发的视觉语言模型为0.748(第4.4节)。 表5列出了这些结果。 没有参照国返回审计的每一项产出,在测试飞机上,在限制判决的宏观-F1中,在指定被违反的制约和被改变的字段或被改变的字段的修复错误时,没有参照国在NeSySpec之前;在记录和对子检测中,剩余部分和晚聚变部分的学习者接近它,在某些环境下排名较高(第4.1节)。

blocks.en: Among the approaches evaluated here - the DL2 method on the declared fields, the network trained with the DL2 loss on the same residuals read per constraint, a constraint-layer repair ordering, LTN ablations, solver and rule diagnosis and prompted language and vision-language models -, NeSySpec is, to our knowledge, the most suitable neuro-symbolic framework for auditing engineering specifications: it provides and evaluates together the seven outputs of Table 2 , from constraint verdicts and field localization to part-grounded image evidence and a verification report. Its logic contributes more to the physical audit than to record classification. Training its knowledge base through Real Logic (the differentiable formulation of first-order fuzzy logic underlying LTN [ 19 ] ) improves detection over the same knowledge base left at its initial values. Detection also improves as more knowledge is encoded, a trend shared by a residual MLP using the same constraints (Section 4.8 ). Only the knowledge base, visual predicates, corruption generator and data of NeSySpec are aircraft-specific, so another engineered system enters through these four parts (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 本文评价的方法包括:关于申报领域的DL2方法、通过DL2损失对相同残留物进行培训的网络按每个约束值读取、限制层修复命令、LTN调制、解析器和规则诊断以及激发语言和视觉语言模型,据我们所知,NeSySpec是审计工程规格最合适的神经-神经系统框架:它提供并共同评价表2的7项产出,从强制裁定和实地本地化到部分依据的图像证据和核查报告。 它的逻辑对实物审计的贡献大于记录分类. 通过Real Logic培训其知识库(LTN基础的一阶模糊逻辑的不同表述[19])改进了对最初数值所剩的同一知识库的检测。 随着更多的知识被编码,检测工作也有所改进,而残余的MLP使用同样的限制来分享这一趋势(第4.8节)。 只有NeSySpec的知识库,视觉上游,腐败生成器和数据是飞机专用的,所以另一个工程系统通过这四个部分(Appendix A.)进入.

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are: • An integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework on Logic Tensor Networks whose graded residual-aware axioms, trained on fleet data, give each physical constraint of a declared engineering specification a held, violated or masked verdict and derive from these verdicts the altered field, a repair proposal, an exact accounting of missing evidence, part-grounded visual evidence and a verification report; • A verification protocol that re-estimates the priors from training records, refits the generator oracle without test or out-of-distribution aircraft, labels errors independently of the generator, reads the held and violated verdicts against per-constraint labels and stress-tests the verdicts against falsification and human part annotations; • A comparative study of rule-based and solver-based methods, models trained with constraint losses, language and vision-language models, and residual learners, all using the same physical knowledge base (Table 5 ). NeSySpec identifies the violated constraint more often than classical diagnosis, DL2 applied to the declared fields, and a prompted language model. It also identifies the altered field more often than minimum-cardinality localization with random tie-breaking and produces a repair proposal from the same violation degrees (Figure 6 ); • A deployment map (Table 6 ) that assigns each audit question to the output of NeSySpec that answers it, including its optional rank-then-explain alarm and critical-field alert.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献是: 在逻辑天线网上建立一个综合的、可解释的神经系统审计框架,其残留知觉轴线分级,经过机队数据培训,使所宣布的工程规格受到每个物理制约,并获得经修改的场面、修复提案、对缺失证据的准确核算、部分有根据的视觉证据和核查报告; 核查协议,重新估计培训记录中的前科,在没有测试或分配外飞机的情况下使发电机甲骨文改用,将错误标注在发电机之外,对所持有的和违反的标注进行阅读,并对对伪造和人为部分说明的判决进行压力测试; 对基于规则和解的方法、受过限制损失训练的模型、语言和视觉模式以及剩余学习者进行比较研究,所有方法都使用相同的物理知识基础(表5)。 NeSySpec比经典诊断更经常地识别被违反的制约,DL2应用到已宣布的字段,以及一个被激发的语言模型. 该系统还更经常地识别经改变的字段,而不是随机解带的最小心动定位,并生成来自相同违规度(图6)的修复建议; 部署图(表6),将每个审计问题分配给NeSySpec的输出,以回答它,包括其可选的当时的级别警报和关键场警报。

blocks.en: An integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework on Logic Tensor Networks whose graded residual-aware axioms, trained on fleet data, give each physical constraint of a declared engineering specification a held, violated or masked verdict and derive from these verdicts the altered field, a repair proposal, an exact accounting of missing evidence, part-grounded visual evidence and a verification report;
blocks.zh: 对逻辑天线网进行综合和可解释的神经系统审计框架,该网络的剩余意识轴线分级,经过车队数据培训,使所申报的工程规格的每个物理约束都得到维持、违反或掩盖的判决,并从这些判决中得出已改变的场面、修理建议、对缺失证据的准确核算、部分有根据的视觉证据和核查报告;

blocks.en: A verification protocol that re-estimates the priors from training records, refits the generator oracle without test or out-of-distribution aircraft, labels errors independently of the generator, reads the held and violated verdicts against per-constraint labels and stress-tests the verdicts against falsification and human part annotations;
blocks.zh: 核查协议,重新估计训练记录中的前科,在未经试验或分配外飞机的情况下重新调整发电机甲骨文,将错误标出在发电机之外,阅读所持有的和违反的对每个限制标签的判决,并测试对伪造和人为部分说明的判决;

blocks.en: A comparative study of rule-based and solver-based methods, models trained with constraint losses, language and vision-language models, and residual learners, all using the same physical knowledge base (Table 5 ). NeSySpec identifies the violated constraint more often than classical diagnosis, DL2 applied to the declared fields, and a prompted language model. It also identifies the altered field more often than minimum-cardinality localization with random tie-breaking and produces a repair proposal from the same violation degrees (Figure 6 );
blocks.zh: 对基于规则和解决方法的比较研究,接受过约束损失、语言和视觉语言模型培训的模型,以及剩余学习者,都使用相同的物理知识基础(表5)。 NeSySpec比经典诊断更经常地识别被违反的制约,DL2应用到已宣布的字段,以及一个被激发的语言模型. 该系统还更经常地识别经改变的字段,而不是使用随机断结的最小心动定位,并生成来自相同违规度的修复建议(图6);

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews background and related works. Section 3 presents the NeSySpec framework in full. Section 4 reports experimental results. Section 5 concludes with directions for future work. Appendix A describes how to port NeSySpec to other engineered systems.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Background
blocks.zh: 2.1 背景情况

blocks.en:
LTN [ 19 ] implement Real Logic, a first-order language whose symbols are interpreted on data by a parametric grounding 𝒢 Θ \mathcal{G}_{\Theta} : constants are mapped to tensors of real features, variables to sequences of individuals, and predicates to differentiable functions into [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .
Fuzzy connectives and aggregators make the truth of every formula of a knowledge base 𝒦 \mathcal{K} differentiable, so that Θ \Theta is learnable from data.
In NeSySpec an individual is a declared record with its availability mask and an optional image, and the predicates are graded physical predicates and visual attribute heads (Sections 3.2 and 3.3 ).
From the product configuration [ 19 , 21 ] , NeSySpec uses the negation ¬ a = 1 − a \neg a=1-a , the product t-norm a ∧ b = a ​ b a\wedge b=ab and the Reichenbach implication a → b = I R ​ ( a , b ) = 1 − a + a ​ b a\rightarrow b=I_{R}(a,b)=1-a+ab .
The abovementioned implication passes its consequent the gradient ∂ I R / ∂ b = a \partial I_{R}/\partial b=a , where the residuated Goguen and Łukasiewicz implications pass none wherever a ≤ b a\leq b [ 21 ] , so the localization pressure of the grounding axiom P k → Loc k P_{k}\rightarrow\mathrm{Loc}_{k} on a visual head grows with the truth of its own assertion (Section 3.3 ).

Guarded quantification, ∀ x ⁡ [ g ⁡ ( x ) ] : φ ⁡ ( x ) \forall x\,[g(x)]\colon\varphi(x) , aggregates only over the individuals that satisfy a crisp condition g g and passes no gradient to the others [ 19 ] .

blocks.en: Our formulation of the audit in Real Logic has four properties. First, the bands and slopes of graded predicates are learned through their truth values, jointly with the record verdict. Second, guarded quantification uses evidence availability as its guard: constraints whose required evidence is missing are excluded, and the verdict reduces exactly to that of the available constraints (Proposition 1 ). Third, physical predicates and visual heads share a common truth scale, allowing cross-modal axioms to enter the same knowledge base. Finally, the grounding axiom uses the Reichenbach implication to scale the localization pressure with the truth of the visual predicate.
blocks.zh: 我们以真实逻辑进行的审计有四个属性。 一,分级上游的带和坡度通过真实值学习,结合记录判断. 第二,谨慎的量化方法以证据的可得性为保障:排除了缺少必要证据的制约,判决完全缩小到现有制约(建议1)。 第三,物理上游和视觉头部共享一个共同的真理尺度,允许跨模式轴线进入相同的知识库. 最后,搁浅的axiom使用Reichenbach的暗示,用视觉上游的真实性来放大本地化的压力.

blocks.en: In the specification stratum, learned graded predicates are aggregated by a masked mean, with no logical connectives between them. Each axiom therefore retains its own truth value at inference, and the record verdict decomposes into constraint-level verdicts. Crisp rule validation also provides exact abstention (Table 2 ), and Section 4.8 examines the contribution of each of the four properties.
blocks.zh: 在规格层中,学习到的分级的上游由一个蒙面的平均值汇总,它们之间没有逻辑连接. 因此,每个轴心机构在推论上都保留了自己的真理价值,而记录判决则分解为约束级判决。 Crisp规则验证也提供了确切的弃权(表2),第4.8节审查了四个财产中每个财产的贡献。

blocks.en: 2.2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2.2 相关工程

blocks.en: Specification auditing draws on several lines of research, from detecting and repairing errors in structured records to combining domain knowledge with visual evidence. We review work on data editing and diagnosis, learned anomaly detection, differentiable logic and neuro-symbolic reasoning, explanation supervision, and multimodal verification.
blocks.zh: 规格审计借鉴了几条研究线索,从发现和修复结构化记录的错误,到将域知识与视觉证据相结合. 我们审查关于数据编辑和诊断、了解的异常检测、不同逻辑和神经-症状推理、解释监督和多式联运核查的工作。

blocks.en:
Physics-driven correction flags machine-learning estimates of design parameters, such as those of an aero engine, whose accumulated physical error exceeds a threshold, and corrects them by surrogate-assisted optimization against physical evaluations [ 22 ] ; NeSySpec works from fleet data without a simulator and names the constraint that fails. Fellegi–Holt editing localizes errors by finding the minimum-weight set of fields whose modification satisfies every edit [ 13 ] . Data validation leaves a rule with a missing value unevaluated [ 23 ] . Data repair methods, benchmarked by Ni et al. [ 24 ] , correct cells through probabilistic inference under integrity constraints in HoloClean [ 25 ] or using a few example repairs in Baran [ 26 ] . The satisfiability modulo theories (SMT) solver Z3 [ 27 ] returns conflict sets for consistency-based diagnosis [ 14 ] as unsatisfiable cores. It also supports minimum-cardinality localization through MaxSMT [ 28 ] . Rule engines and language models check building designs against codes [ 29 , 30 ] .
Their bounds, where present, are crisp, set by experts or mined from data [ 31 ] , and they take no image evidence; NeSySpec grades every constraint against bands learned from the fleet, ranks the violated constraints by the graded degrees of its own verdict, localizes the altered field by abduction with no oracle to break ties and adds image evidence (Sections 4.2 and 4.3 ). A reference architecture for auditing mechanical engineering drawings checks the entities read from them against a standards knowledge graph [ 32 ] . Hybrid fault diagnosis pairs model-based residuals with anomaly classifiers [ 33 ] , or residuals learned from fault-free data with consistency-based isolation [ 34 ] , and a neuro-symbolic architecture lets knowledge-based and learned methods support each other in anomaly detection and fault diagnosis [ 35 ] , a division of labor that NeSySpec offers as its optional rank-then-explain alarm, a residual-learner alarm explained by the violated constraint.

blocks.en: TabPFN v2 [ 10 ] and AnoLLM [ 11 ] score records by in-context learning and language-model likelihood, RegValidator checks the detection ideas of a language model with data-validation rules [ 36 ] , GIDCL detects and corrects errors with a graph network and cleaning rules generated by a language model [ 37 ] , and ZeroED detects erroneous values without manual labels through language-model reasoning [ 38 ] . NeSySpec returns, for each record, which constraints the record respects and which it violates, the altered field, a repair proposal and the evidence coverage, together with a score; Section 4.4 compares the scores in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve - AUROC.

blocks.en: Neuro-symbolic methods use explicit knowledge to guide learning and reasoning. Frameworks such as LTN, DeepProbLog [ 42 ] , Scallop [ 43 ] and NeurASP [ 44 ] combine trainable models with logical reasoning. Knowledge can also enter through training objectives or mechanisms that constrain or refine predictions, as in abductive learning [ 45 ] , DL2 [ 20 ] , the semantic loss [ 46 ] , constraint layers [ 47 , 64 ] and Knowledge Enhanced Neural Networks (KENN) [ 48 ] . Probabilistic soft logic (PSL) infers truth values for open atoms under weighted rules [ 50 ] . Logic Explained Networks (LEN) extract rules from a trained network [ 49 ] . These frameworks can compute a truth, a probability or a distance to satisfaction per formula, from which a violated constraint can be read by an argmax or argmin, can carry a tolerance band as a neural or weighted predicate, and marginalize, infer or leave free what is unobserved (Table 2 , note b). Encoding NeSySpec’s knowledge base in DeepProbLog, Scallop or PSL would change its axiomatic and logical structure, with probabilistic facts and proofs in place of graded truths and masked quantification, so that comparison is left to future work (Section 5 ). NeSySpec joins these per-constraint truths with tolerance bands learned from the fleet, abstention under missing evidence (Proposition 1 ), a search for the altered field with its repair through the same degrees, part-grounded image evidence and a per-record report, provided and evaluated together, which no cited work does; Sections 4.2 and 4.8 compare it with the DL2 method on the declared fields and with a network trained with the DL2 loss on the same residuals, which returns per-constraint probabilities. LTN has grounded part-of relations, fault signatures, process traces [ 39 , 65 , 66 ] , fault-diagnosis rules for gearboxes and rotating machinery [ 40 , 41 ] and medical rules with learnable thresholds [ 18 ] ; an answer set program names the missing, misplaced or wrongly connected component of electrical control panels after a separately trained detector [ 55 ] , and GuardEn executes compiled safety rules on scene graphs of an image [ 56 ] ; NeSySpec adds graded constraints against bands learned from the fleet and visual predicates grounded in the parts they describe (Section 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 神经符号方法使用显性知识来指导学习和推理. LTN,DeepProbLog[42],扇贝[43]和NeurASP[44]等框架将可训练模型与逻辑推理相结合. 知识也可以通过限制或完善预测的培训目标或机制进入,例如在绑架性学习[45]、DL2[20]、语义损失[46]、约束层[47、64]和知识增强神经网络[48]中。 概率软逻辑(PSL)在加权规则下推断开放原子的真值[50]. 逻辑解释网络(LEN)从训练有素的网络中提取规则[49]. 这些框架可以计算出每个公式的真理、概率或满足的距离,从这些公式中,被违反的制约可以通过一个正弦或正弦读取,可以带一个容忍带作为神经或加权的上游,并边缘化、推断或留下未观察的东西(表2,注b)。 将NeSySpec在DeepProbLog、Scayop或PSL的知识库编码,将改变其逻辑和逻辑结构,以概率性事实和证据取代分级的真理和隐蔽的量化,从而将比较留给今后的工作(第5节)。 NeSySpec用从舰队学到的耐受性乐队加入这些每个约束的真理,在缺失的证据下弃权(Proposition 1 ),通过同样程度的修补,部分根据的图像证据和每张记录的报告来搜索被改变的球场,共同提供和评价,没有引用过任何作品;第4.2节和第4.8节将其与申报球场上的DL2方法比较,并用同一剩余球场上的DL2损失训练的网络进行对比,后者返回了每个约束概率. LTN基于部分关系,断层签名,过程痕迹[39,65,66],变速箱和旋转机械的断层诊断规则[40,41]和具有可学习阈值的医学规则[18];一个解答集程序在经过单独训练的探测器[55]之后命名了电气控制面板中缺失的,错位的或错误连接的部件[55],GuardEn在图像的场景图上执行汇编的安全规则[56];NeSySpec增加了对从舰队中吸取的波段和它们描述的部分的视觉上游的分级限制(第4.6节)。

blocks.en:
Explanation-guided learning adds supervision on model explanations [ 67 ] . Right for the Right Reasons (RRR) penalizes input gradients in regions annotated as irrelevant [ 57 ] , while GradMask penalizes them outside the annotated region [ 58 ] . RES learns from imprecise human masks [ 59 ] . The Energy loss of Rao et al. [ 60 ] increases the share of positive attribution inside annotated bounding boxes, and Pukdee et al. [ 61 ] learn from explanation constraints satisfied in expectation.
NeSySpec expresses part-level supervision as an axiom on each head’s class-activation map, gated by the head’s assertion and guarded by part visibility. Section 4.6 compares this approach with RRR, GradMask and Pukdee et al. under a common protocol.

TIP pre-trains on images and masked tables for incomplete tabular data [ 62 ] , and AutoGluon-Multimodal (AutoGluon-MM) fuses tables and images with foundation models [ 63 ] .
The fused verdict of NeSySpec aggregates its strata without labels and reduces exactly to the available constraints, and Section 4.4 compares it with these fusions; its cross-modal axioms read the attributes predicted by the visual heads, as concept bottleneck models predict a label from predicted concepts [ 68 ] . Open vision-language models [ 53 , 69 ] can judge whether a record and an image agree and a language model [ 52 ] whether a record is coherent, and vision-language models have been benchmarked on engineering rules, computer-aided design renderings and drawings, where they still struggle [ 54 ] ; NeSySpec returns with its judgment a verdict for every constraint (Section 4.4 ).

blocks.en: Table 2 compares the reviewed approaches on seven outputs needed for specification auditing: identification of the violated constraint, localization of the altered field, a repair proposal, exact abstention under missing evidence, learned tolerances, part-grounded image evidence, and a per-record verification report. To our knowledge, none of the reviewed works provides and evaluates all seven outputs together. Statistical data editing and validation come closest, with crisp bounds set by experts or fitted to data and no image evidence. The neuro-symbolic formulation of NeSySpec uses graded constraint violation degrees for the largest-violation key and for abductive field localization, without an oracle to break ties (Sections 4.2 and 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 表2比较了经过审查的关于规格审计所需7项产出的方法:查明被违反的限制因素、改变的栏目的本地化、一项修理建议、在缺失的证据下确切弃权、了解的容忍度、部分根据的图像证据以及每一份记录的核查报告。 据我们所知,任何经审查的作品都没有提供和评价所有七项产出。 统计数据的编辑和验证最接近,专家设置了简明的界限,或符合数据,没有图像证据。 NeSySpec的神经-连锁配方对最大的侵犯钥匙和绑架场局部化使用分级约束性违规度,没有甲骨文来断开联系(第4.2和4.3节)。

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en:
NeSySpec audits a declared record in one integrated, interpretable NeSy framework: through its logical axioms it gives a held or violated verdict on each physical relation that binds the record’s fields and, when an image is paired with it, on whether the image agrees. The framework is organized into seven modules (Figure 1 ), built on Real Logic (Section 2.1 ). Guarded quantification allows each axiom to contribute only when its required evidence is available (E1), while graded predicates express how well each constraint is satisfied (E2). A grounding axiom ties visual predictions to the relevant image parts (E3), and stratification preserves a separate verdict for each evidence source (E4). A monotone second head complements the main verdict with an additional score and diagnosis key (E5). • Data and Verification Instances encode records and images, then generate corrupted examples and controls; • Knowledge Base and Graded Predicates grade each constraint by a violation degree, with bands and slopes learned from the fleet (E2); • Vision Module and Grounding Axiom encourage each head to place its evidence on its part (E3); • Cross-Modal Axioms compare visual posteriors with declared fields; • Masked Stratified Aggregation guards each axiom by its availability, so the verdict reduces exactly to the available evidence (E1), with one stratum per evidence source (E4); • Verdict and Diagnosis Keys return the verdict and name the violated constraint, with a monotone second head (E5); • Verification Report and Optional Checks give the altered field, a repair proposal and the report, with three optional settings of the audit. The verdict is the masked mean of the constraint degrees, so it decomposes into constraint-level verdicts, from which the violated constraint, the altered field, the repair, the accounting of missing evidence and the report follow; detection is one of these outputs. Algorithm in Appendix transcribes the forward pass from the code. In our framework, we used the LTNtorch library [ 70 ] .
Appendix B describes the organization of the implementation and gives an example of a verification report.
blocks.zh:
NeSySpec对一个综合的,可解释的NeSy框架中的已宣布的记录进行审计:它通过其逻辑定理,对约束记录的字段的每个物理关系以及当一个图像与它配对时,对图像是否同意作出持有或违反的判决。 该框架分为7个单元(图1),以真实逻辑为基础(第2.1节)。 谨慎的量化允许每个动因仅在获得所需证据(E1)时才能作出贡献,而分级的上游则表明每项制约是否得到满足(E2)。 一个落地轴将视觉预测与相关图像部分(E3)联系起来,分层为每个证据来源(E4)保留单独的判断. 单音第二头以附加分数和诊断键(E5)补充主判. · 数据和核查实例编码记录和图像,然后生成腐败的例子和控制; 判决是受约束程度的蒙蔽的表示,因此它分解成受约束一级的判决,从中违反的制约,改变的字段,修复,对缺失证据的衡算和报告遵循;发现是这些产出之一. 附录中的算法将代码中的前传转录下来. 在我们的框架内,我们使用了LTNtorch库[70].

blocks.zh: 知识基础和分级的预测按违规程度分级,从舰队中学习波段和坡度(E2);

blocks.en: Vision Module and Grounding Axiom encourage each head to place its evidence on its part (E3);
blocks.zh: 《远景模块》和《地心轴》鼓励每个头都提出证据(E3);

blocks.en: Cross-Modal Axioms compare visual posteriors with declared fields;
blocks.zh: Cross-Modal Axioms 将视觉后遗症与宣布的田地进行比较;

blocks.en: Masked Stratified Aggregation guards each axiom by its availability, so the verdict reduces exactly to the available evidence (E1), with one stratum per evidence source (E4);
blocks.zh: 根据证据的可得性,蒙面分层聚合物每个轴心卫士,因此判决完全减少为现有证据(E1),每个证据来源各一个层(E4);

blocks.en: Verdict and Diagnosis Keys return the verdict and name the violated constraint, with a monotone second head (E5);
blocks.zh: 诊断和诊断 密钥返回判决,并命名被违反的限制,并有一个单调第二头(E5);

blocks.en: Verification Report and Optional Checks give the altered field, a repair proposal and the report, with three optional settings of the audit.
blocks.zh: 核查报告和任择 检查给出了修改后的字段,修补建议和报告,有三种选择的审计设置.

blocks.en: The domain enters NeSySpec through the knowledge base, the visual predicates, the corruption generator and the data; masked aggregation, graded predicates, grounding axiom, keys, report and protocol are written to apply unchanged to engineered systems whose declared fields obey physical, definitional or regulatory relations with statable tolerances; fitted parameters and numbers concern aircraft. Appendix A lists what a port to another engineered system requires.
blocks.zh: 域名通过知识库,视觉上游,腐败生成器和数据进入NeSySpec;蒙面聚合,分级上游,搁浅轴,密钥,报告和协议被写成适用于那些其申报的域服从物理,定义或监管关系与可统计容忍度的工程系统;安装参数和数字涉及飞机. 附 录 一个列出一个端口到另一个工程系统的需要.

blocks.en: The specification benchmark splits the records by family: the business-jet families form the unseen class, six random families the unseen families, and the others fill training, validation and test at 60/20/20 (Appendix ). Each clean record yields up to two instances of each of five corruption families: an impossible single value and geometric, performance and cruise inconsistencies multiply or divide one field by 1 + ϵ 1+\epsilon , with ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 and 0.10 0.10 , and a cross-class block swap (Frankenstein) copies a coherent block of fields from another class in the same split. The generator oracle, a crisp check of the same relations against class bands [ 0.88 ​ min , 1.12 ​ max ] [0.88\min,\,1.12\max] of each quantity over all 107 clean aircraft of every split, keeps an instance only when it flags the target constraint (any constraint for a swap); otherwise ϵ \epsilon doubles, for at most six attempts (Table ; realized instances in Figure 2 (d)). The verifier is fitted on training-split instances only: the oracle’s bands reach it through their labels and per-constraint targets, which thus carry the class extremes of all 107 aircraft, and no field value of another split enters training. Two noisy-but-coherent controls per record perturb each continuous field by a Gaussian factor with relative standard deviation 0.02, with 𝐴𝑅 \mathit{AR} rescaled according to the induced change in b 2 / S b^{2}/S ; both controls must remain coherent. The intervention benchmark (2,582 rows, same aircraft and splits) draws the same operators once per magnitude, without escalation or oracle certification, and labels each row from the edit alone. A row is labeled incoherent when a continuous field differs from its clean source by more than three noise standard deviations or an integer field changes. These tolerances are fixed before generation, and the label applies regardless of whether a physical relation is violated. An available constraint receives a positive label when its scope includes such an altered field. Noisy copies and edits within tolerance count as unaltered. These labels evaluate the constraint verdicts, the diagnosis key, abduction and detection. The satellite and multimodal benchmarks likewise include corrupted examples and controls. In the multimodal benchmark, each image is paired with its matching record, a mismatched record, or an altered version of its matching record. Mismatches involve aircraft from another class or role, or a sister variant. Occluded and degraded photographs serve as controls..

blocks.en: The train prior fits every data-dependent band on the 44 clean training aircraft and widens it to [ 0.88 ​ min , 1.12 ​ max ] [0.88\min,\,1.12\max] , as the oracle does. The bands start from the train prior and are learned with their slopes from the fleet and its labeled corruptions, so they act as learned tolerances: 45.7% of them keep both edges inside the training fleet range widened in the same way, and the others, all wing-loading bands among them, extend beyond it after training (Appendix ). The learned slopes act as implicit per-constraint weights. In hierarchical banks each band or tolerance parameter of a class is a fleet value plus a class offset with the same weight, so a class without training aircraft, such as the business jets, is read with fleet statistics and parameters. The remote-sensing axioms follow the same recipe: six graded slots (R1, R2 for civil and for military roles, R3, R4 and R10) read the residual in standard units of the clean training rows, and the logical axioms R5 to R9 enter as the negative logarithm of their truth. Each tabular stratum’s settings (the power p p of a masked power mean of the degrees, the in-band term, flat or hierarchical banks) are chosen on validation alone among eight candidates trained with eight seeds each; both strata select p = 1 p=1 , the masked mean of Eq. ( 9 ), and on generator-oracle labels the specification stratum keeps the in-band term and hierarchical banks.

blocks.en: 3.4 Cross-Modal Axioms
blocks.zh: 3.4 跨潮流轴

blocks.en: The cross-modal axioms (Table ; center of Figure 2 ) compare declared attributes with the visual posteriors p vis ( ⋅ ∣ I ) p_{\mathrm{vis}}(\cdot\mid I) predicted from the image. For each predicate, the posterior is obtained by a softmax over its heads, or a sigmoid for a binary predicate. Axiom truths are computed from these posteriors, expected truths of implications, or products of such terms, without additional trainable parameters. An axiom is available when its declared value is covered by the corresponding visual head and the relevant parts are visible.

Either way it depends neither on the degree or truth of a masked axiom nor on a field read only by masked axioms, and has zero derivative with respect to them.
(b) With a tabular stratum ( λ 𝒯 > 0 \lambda_{\mathcal{T}}>0 ), if I = ∅ I=\varnothing , or every cross-modal axiom is masked, then feas ⁡ ( x , I ) = exp ⁡ ( − V 𝒯 ​ ( x ) ) \mathrm{feas}(x,I)=\exp\big(-V_{\mathcal{T}}(x)\big) exactly; otherwise feas ⁡ ( x , I ) \mathrm{feas}(x,I) is the verdict of the knowledge base restricted to the strata present (including the tabular stratum at feasibility 1 / 2 1/2 when none of its axioms is available), with their weights renormalized.

The proof is in Appendix . The reduction holds because only available axioms enter the mean, a structural property of E1 that also holds in training, where a masked axiom receives zero gradient; its practical value is an exact abstention, which crisp rule validation shares (Table 2 ) and learned heads do not keep (Section 4.5 ); stratification (E4) keeps one verdict per evidence source (Section 4.8 ).

blocks.en: 3.6 Verdict and Diagnosis Keys
blocks.zh: 3.6 判断和诊断关键

blocks.en: NeSySpec’s verdict is V = − ln ⁡ feas ⁡ ( x , I ) V=-\ln\mathrm{feas}(x,I) , the masked mean degree V 𝒯 V_{\mathcal{T}} for a record without image. Bands and slopes are learned for each derived quantity, with no additional weights learned for aggregation. The resulting verdict serves as the record score. NeSySpec converts this score into a binary decision using the threshold t ⋆ t^{\star} that maximizes Youden’s index on the validation set [ 78 ] . A specification record with no available constraint scores V = ln ⁡ 2 V=\ln 2 , above the validation thresholds of the specification verifier (0.310 to 0.558 across seeds), so it is flagged for lack of evidence, with an evidence coverage of 0 in its report (Section 3.7 ). For a flagged specification record with at least one available constraint, constraint diagnosis identifies the constraint with the largest violation degree. This gives the largest-violation key : the argmax of the degrees entering the verdict, with no additional parameter to fit. We also retain a secondary key , identifying the constraint that contributes most to the second head’s score. ( 3 ) alone equals ln ⁡ 2 \ln 2 , or inside the band where the learned in-band term adds to it (A1, A2); it is held otherwise, and a masked constraint is not evaluated. The rule has no tuned parameter: it reads at 0.5 the truths that the per-constraint term of Eq. ( 4 ) trains toward 1 on constraints the generator leaves held and toward 0 on those it violates. Its evidence coverage counts the available constraints among those whose scope contains the record, so a masked axiom is an abstention, and the report gives the class of the nearest clean training record and its fleet similarity exp ( − d / τ ) \exp(-d/\tau) , with d d the root-mean-square difference from it over the fields both records declare, in log-scaled standardized coordinates, and τ \tau the median leave-one-out nearest-neighbor d d in the clean training fleet, so that a value below e − 1 e^{-1} marks a record farther from the fleet than a typical clean training record.

blocks.en: NeSySpec’s audit has three optional settings. With rank-then-explain , the residual MLP, an MLP on the 14 physical quantities of the oracle (Table ), raises the alarm at its validation Youden threshold and the largest-violation key explains each flagged record; the flagged-and-diagnosed rate, the share of corrupted records flagged with a violated top-ranked constraint, scores this setting. The critical-field alert flags a record that leaves undeclared a field required by an applicable axiom and declared by at least 95% of the training records of its class - or of its engine type for classes with fewer than five training records -, reading only the undeclared fields, the class, the engine type and a table of the training records; with it enabled, NeSySpec flags a record when its verdict or the alert fires. With MICE imputation of the missing fields enabled, NeSySpec scores imputed values in place of abstaining on them; Section 4.5 compares this setting with learners given the same imputer.
blocks.zh: NeSySpec的审计有三个可选设置. 其余的MLP是甲骨文14个物理量的MLP(表), 临界场警报旗上有一个记录,它留下了适用的轴线要求的未申报的字段,并且至少95%的培训记录 -- -- 或培训记录少于5个的班级的引擎类型 -- -- 宣布了该字段,只读出未申报的字段、班级、引擎类型和培训记录表;有了它,NeSySpec在判决或警报火灾时会标出记录。 随着MICE对缺失字段的估算被启用,NeSySpec的分数被推算出值,以取代弃权值;第4.5节将这种设置与学习者作比较,给出了同样的杂质。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation and Results
blocks.zh: 4 评价和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The vision module and the tabular verifier are fitted separately, as described in Section 3 (Table , Appendix ); where a result uses one of NeSySpec’s optional settings, rank-then-explain, the critical-field alert or MICE imputation, the text names it. The configuration was selected on validation data and held-out training classes. The reported results use a visibility threshold calibrated on a subset including test and out-of-distribution images, and generator labels from an oracle fitted on all 107 aircraft (Appendix ). Sensitivity analyses at the end of this section repeat threshold selection and oracle fitting without test or out-of-distribution data.
blocks.zh: 如第3节(表,附录)所述,视觉模块和表格验证器是单独安装的;如果结果使用NeSySpec的可选设置之一,即按级解释、临界场警报或MICE计算,则文字名称。 该配置是在验证数据和预留训练课上选择的. 报告的结果使用一个分集的可见度阈值校准,包括测试和分配外图像,以及所有107架飞机上安装的甲骨文的发电机标签(附录)。 本节末尾的敏感性分析重复了阈值选择和甲骨文装配,而没有测试数据或分配数据.

blocks.en: Table 4 maps each benchmark to its labels and to the sections that use it; every error in this study is synthetic, an edit or a constructed mismatch of public records and images. Two label families recur. Generator labels come from the generator oracle of Section 3.1 , which judges the same residual quantities as the knowledge base against class bands fitted on all 107 aircraft; its single-field corruptions are escalated from 5 or 10% until the oracle flags them, mostly to 20 to 160% (geometric ones stay at 5 or 10%; Table ). Intervention labels cover single-field edits drawn once at 5 to 80% and cross-class block swaps: a field counts as altered beyond three noise standard deviations (0.06 in natural-log units for continuous fields, 0.134 for the aspect ratio, any change of an integer field), so edits within this tolerance, e.g., the 5% edits of continuous fields, count as unaltered, and a constraint is labeled when its scope contains an altered field. Such a constraint is involved in the edit, which need not violate it: an edit can keep the record inside the physical envelope of the fleet, and 613 of the 1,810 altered rows, about a third, break no constraint even under bands fitted on all 107 aircraft, so that no physical check can flag them (Appendix ). Generator labels follow the same relations as the axioms and were NeSySpec’s per-constraint training targets; intervention labels, set from the edit alone, are independent of them. Minimum-cardinality localization (Fellegi-Holt and MaxSMT [ 28 ] , all optimal solutions) breaks ties at random unless the oracle tie-break is named.
blocks.zh: 表4绘制了每个基准的标签和使用该基准的章节;本研究中的每一个错误都是合成,编辑或构建的公共记录和图像不匹配. 两个标签家庭再次出现。 发电机的标签来自第3.1节的发电机甲骨文,该节根据所有107架飞机上安装的班段对知识库作出同样的剩余量判断;其单场腐败从5%或10%升级到甲骨文标注,大多数升至20%至160%(几何数保持在5%或10%;表)。 干预标签覆盖了一次在5-80%时绘制的单字段编辑和跨类块互换:一个字段计数的改变超过3个噪声标准差(连续字段的自然日志单位0.06,侧面比的0.134,整数字段的任何变化),因此在这个容量范围内进行编辑,例如连续字段的5%的编辑,计数为未更改的,当其范围包含一个改变字段时,一个约束被贴标签. 这种约束涉及编辑,不需要违反:编辑可以将记录保存在机队的物理信封内,在1,810条修改过的行中,有613条,约三分之一,即使安装在所有107架飞机上的波段下也无法打破约束,因此任何物理检查都不能标注(附录 ). NeSySpec的每个约束性训练目标; 仅从编辑中设定的干预标签独立于它们。 最小心肌局部化(Fellegi-Holt and MaxSMT [28],所有最佳解决方案)随意断开联系,除非甲骨文结节命名.

blocks.en: Intervals are 95% two-level cluster-bootstrap percentile intervals [ 87 ] , reported as [aircraft] ⋅ \cdot [family] for records. The ± \pm notation denotes standard deviation across seeds. Residual MLP and NeSySpec runs are paired by seed. A method is higher or lower than another, ahead or below, when both intervals of their difference exclude zero, and on par with it when both include zero; when only one excludes zero, when a bound prints 0.000 or lies within 0.003 of zero, or when the reading changes in one of 20 alternative bootstrap streams, the text gives the levels in plain words (close, comparable, slightly). The text gives levels, Tables to and Appendix the differences and intervals, and Appendix the spread over seeds and the readings across the alternative streams; no multiplicity correction is applied.

blocks.en: Learners on the raw fields or on the residuals, the 14 physical quantities that the oracle checks, score records (the residual MLP, TabPFN v2 [ 10 ] , LightGBM [ 88 ] , a one-class support vector machine, SVM); class standardization and the grouped Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) [ 12 ] of a second model (MLP-SHAP, LightGBM-SHAP) rank the residuals; Fellegi-Holt, Z3 and rule checkers return crisp violated sets, a network trained with the DL2 loss [ 20 ] on the same residuals a probability per constraint, and language and vision-language models given the rules a judgment (Table ). We call V V the record verdict and the held or violated outputs per constraint the constraint verdicts. The constraint verdicts use exact-set agreement per record, macro-F1 over the constraints with at least five labeled violations and the false-violation rate on clean records. Diagnosis and localization use top-1 rates, repair the log-space error and grounding the pointing game [ 89 ] ; detection scores the record verdict by AUROC and the false-positive rate (FPR) on the 32 controls at a true-positive rate (TPR) of 0.90. Experiments ran on an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D with 192 GB of RAM, an NVIDIA RTX 5090 and an RTX 4090. Per record, the verdict and the key take one pass through the knowledge base, abduction evaluates the verdict at 1,201 log-space steps for each field read by an available constraint, and the repair solves one augmented-Lagrangian problem; training curves are in Appendix .
blocks.zh: 原始字段或残片上的学习者,甲骨文检查的14个物理数量,分数记录(残存的MLP, TabPFN v2 [10], LightGBM [88],一个单级辅助矢量机,SVM);分类标准化和分组的第二型号(MLP-SHAP, LightGBM-SHAP)的沙普利添加剂解释[12]对残片进行排位;Fellegi-Holt, Z3和规则检查者返回简洁的违规套件,一个在同样残片上受过DL2损失[20]培训的网络,这种概率为极限,语言和视觉语言模型提供了判断(表))。 我们称V V为记录判决 和持有或违反的产出 限制判决。 强制判决使用每个记录的精确设定协议,宏观-F1对至少5个标注侵权的制约以及清洁记录上的假侵权率. 诊断和本地化采用最高-1率,修补对数空间误差,将指针游戏打下地面[89];检测结果对AUROC的纪录判断和32个控件的假阳性率(FPR)进行评分,真实阳性率为0.90. 实验运行在AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D上,内存192GB,NVIDIA RTX 5090和RTX 4090. 每个记录,判决和关键通过一个知识库,绑架对每个字段的1 201个对数空间步骤进行评估,并用可用的限制读取,修复解决了一个加固-拉格朗日问题;培训曲线载于附录。

blocks.en: Table 5 lines up NeSySpec with its comparators on every output of the audit. Learners on the physical residuals return a record score and need a second model, a head per constraint or attributions, for a verdict or a diagnosis; solvers return a violated set, an edit or a repair; language and vision-language models return a judgment. NeSySpec is the only method that returns every output, and without an image its fused verdict alone returns the record verdict exactly. On the test aircraft no comparator is ahead of it in the macro-F1 of the constraint verdicts, in naming the violated constraint and the altered field or in the repair error on the altered field; the network trained with the DL2 loss keeps fewer false violations (Section 4.2 ). In record and pair detection, learners on the residuals and late fusions are close to NeSySpec and in some settings rank records or pairs higher (Sections 4.4 to 4.5 ). Learners on the residuals do so on the unseen class, after retraining on intervention labels (Table ) and with 10% of the fields hidden, the MLP trained with masks on test and the residual MLP on unseen families; late fusions do so on satellite pairs after learning from labeled pairs, as does Qwen3-VL-32B on photographs of unseen families. With the axiom’s 8 seeds, the auxiliary loss points higher on test pseudo-masks (Section 4.6 , Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 表5 将NeSySpec同其参照方一起列出审计的每一项产出。 物理残存的学习者返回一个记录分数,需要第二个模型,每个约束或归属的头,才能做出判断或诊断;解答者返回一个被违反的集合,编辑或修复;语言和视觉语言模型返回判断. NeSySpec是返回每个输出的唯一方法,如果没有图像,它被熔化的判断就准确地返回记录判断. 在试验飞机上,在限制判决的宏观-F1中,在指定被违反的限制和被改变的场面或被改变的场面上的修理错误方面,没有一个比较者比它领先;受过DL2损失训练的网络保存较少的虚假违规行为(第4.2节)。 在记录和对子检测中,残存物和晚聚变物的学习者接近NeSySpec,在一些环境中排名记录或对子更高(第4.4节至4.5节). 余下部分的学习者在未见课堂上学习,再用干预标签(表)进行再培训,并藏有10%的田地,MLP用口罩进行测试培训,余下MLP则在未见家庭上进行;晚期聚变则在从标签对子学习后在卫星对子上学习,Qune3-VL-32B在未见家庭的照片上也是如此。 用轴的8个种子,试验假面板上的辅助损失点更高(第4.6节,附录)。

blocks.zh: 表5:审计一览:NeSySpec及其参照方对每项产出的审计。

blocks.en: Two further oracles exclude test and out-of-distribution aircraft: the first is fitted on the 44 training aircraft with the paper’s tolerances, the second on the 61 training and validation aircraft with tolerances chosen by leaving one family out. On intervention labels, under both oracles, NeSySpec keeps its leads over Fellegi-Holt and Z3 in diagnosis and over minimum-cardinality localization with random tie-break on every split. It keeps its macro-F1 lead over the DL2-loss network on unseen families under both oracles, on test under the first and slightly under the second, and on the unseen class under the first only. Its narrower leads over the oracle tie-break, the crisp edits and the Class I residual become on par or lower on some splits. Its own levels on test are lower (macro-F1 0.488 and 0.537, abduction 0.532 and 0.491, key 0.732 and, slightly, 0.738, against 0.575, 0.593 and 0.786), and its false violations rise only under the paper’s tolerances, whose bands flag 38 of the 63 clean held-out aircraft and narrow the bands it learns (Appendix ). Re-selected on validation alone, the part detector’s visibility threshold becomes 0.25. Retrained at 0.25, the photograph module keeps its comparisons against the networks without a localization term or with permuted masks and against RRR, GradMask and Pukdee et al. on PASCAL-Part, all kept at 0.20, against the auxiliary loss also retrained at 0.25 and against the vision-language models. Its pointing is slightly lower on test pseudo-masks (0.774 against 0.780) and on PASCAL-Part human masks (0.711 against 0.737), where the auxiliary loss falls as well (0.708 against 0.739), and its cross-modal AUROC is slightly lower on unseen families and the unseen class (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 另有两架甲骨文排除了试验飞机和分配外飞机:第一架安装在44架训练飞机上,具有纸张的耐性;第二架安装在61架训练和鉴定飞机上,具有耐性,选择一个家庭。 在干预标签上,在两个甲骨文下,NeSySpec在诊断和最小心肌局部化方面保持其领先地位于Fellegi-Holt和Z3,并在每分片上随机断结. 它保持其宏观-F1领先于DL2-Loss网络,在两个甲骨文下覆盖看不见的家庭,在第一个和第二个下覆盖测试,在第一个下覆盖看不见的阶层。 它在甲骨文领带断裂、简洁的编辑和I类剩余部分在平分或低分部分。 它自己的测试水平较低(macro-F1 0.488和0.537,绑架 0.532和0.491,关键 0.732和略为0.738,相对0.575,0.593和0.786),其虚假的违规事件只在报纸的容忍度下上升,其63架干净的停机飞机的带旗为38,并缩小了它所学的带(附录 ). 仅在验证时重新选择,部分探测器的能见度阈值变为0.25. 照片模块在0.25时进行了再培训,将其与没有本地化术语的网络或佩戴口罩的网络进行比较,并与PASCAL-Part上的RR、GradMask和Pukdee等人进行比较,所有这些系统都保持在0.20时,辅助损失也在0.25时进行了再培训,与视觉语言模型进行比较。 其指向测试假面(0.774对0.780)和PASCAL-Part人体口罩(0.711对0.737)略低,辅助损失也下降(0.708对0.739),其跨模式AUROC在隐形家庭和隐形类上略低(附录)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Constraint Verdicts and Diagnosis
blocks.zh: 4.2 约束性判决和诊断

blocks.en: For every available constraint of a record, NeSySpec returns a graded degree and, by the fixed rule of Section 3.7 , a held or violated constraint verdict (Figures 4 and 5 ); these verdicts reach a macro-F1 of 0.795 on generator-label test and, without retraining, 0.575 on intervention-label test. Against a network trained with the DL2 loss on the same residuals and per-constraint targets, which returns a probability per constraint, they reach a higher macro-F1 on every split and both label families (the network at 0.661 and 0.426 on the two tests; Figure 6 a), and the same key read from the network ranks the violated constraint first less often on every generator-label split (0.752 against 0.942). They also find every labeled violation of a corrupted record more often than the network on every split and both label families (0.934 against 0.522 on generator-label test; micro recall 0.959 against 0.635), with micro precision on par on test and lower on the unseen class (0.458 against 0.577 on generator and 0.517 against 0.639 on intervention labels; Appendix ). With the network’s thresholds tuned on validation the macro-F1 lead holds on generator-label test and is slight on intervention-label test (0.575 against 0.541; Table ). The network reports fewer false violations on clean records (0.020 against 0.074 on generator-label test, also on intervention labels), and NeSySpec also returns the altered field and a repair proposal from the same degrees.
blocks.zh: 对于记录的每一种现有限制,NeSySpec都会返回一个分级的学位,根据第3.7节的固定规则,持有或违反限制判决(图4和图5);这些判决在发电机标签测试上达到0.795的宏F1,在不进行再培训的情况下,在干预标签测试上达到0.575。 相对于一个经过DL2损失培训的网络,在相同的剩余和每个约束目标上,每个约束返回一个概率,它们在每个分裂和标签家族上达到更高的宏-F1(在两次测试中,网络为0.661和0.426;图6a),从网络读取的同一键在每一个生成器-标签分割上被违反的制约排在首位(0.752对0.942). 他们还发现,每个拆分和标签家庭(0.934对0.522对发电机标签测试;0.959对0.635对)的标签违规情况比网络更常见,在测试中,微精度比微精度低(0.458对0.577对发电机,0.517对0.639对干预标签;附录)。 由于网络的阈值以验证为主,宏观-F1铅在生成器-标签测试上悬浮,在干预-标签测试上略微浮现(0.575对0.541;表......)。 网络报告对清洁记录的不实违规行为较少(0.020对0.074对发电机-标签测试,也针对干预标签),NeSySpec也从相同程度返回被改变的字段和修复建议.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Verification report of one declared record.
blocks.zh: 图5:一份申报记录的核查报告。

blocks.en: Crisp consistency edits on validation-selected bands (Fellegi-Holt and Z3) are on par with the constraint verdicts in macro-F1 on generator labels, and on intervention labels the constraint verdicts lead them on unseen families (0.694 against 0.569; Appendix ); the graded degree ranks the violations, and the largest-violation key names the violated constraint first more often than their complete violated set (below). With thresholds from the specification benchmark’s validation, the constraint verdicts are ahead of the class-standardized residual, MLP-SHAP and LightGBM-SHAP in macro-F1 on test with both label families; with the residual’s thresholds chosen on the intervention benchmark’s validation, the residual is on par with them in macro-F1 on intervention-label test (0.560 against 0.575) and below them in exact-set agreement, with more false violations (0.174 against 0.084). The DL2 method on the declared fields and a language model given the constraints in words are below the constraint verdicts in macro-F1 on every split and label family (the language model on the specification benchmark only).
blocks.zh: 校验所选频段(Fellegi-Holt和Z3)的校验一致性编辑与宏-F1中关于生成器标签的强制裁定相同,在干预标签上,强制裁定导致对隐形家庭(0.694对0.569;附录)的强制裁定;分级等级对违法行为进行排序,被违反的强制裁定的最大关键名称比完全违反的一组(以下)要多。 由于从规格基准的验证中得出了阈值,因此,在宏观-F1中,在与两个标签家族进行测试时,制约性裁定高于类标准化残余、MLP-SHAP和LightGBM-SHAP;在干预基准的验证中选择了剩余阈值,因此,在干预标签测试的宏观-F1(0.560比0.575)中,其剩余值与这些值相等,低于精确设定的协议,存在更多的虚假违规行为(0.174比0.084)。 关于所申报字段的DL2方法和一个语言模型,由于词中的限制,低于宏-F1对每个拆分和标签家族的制约判断(只有规格基准上的语言模型).

blocks.en: Figure 6: Constraint verdicts, diagnosis and field localization.
blocks.zh: 图6:制约性判决、诊断和实地本地化。

blocks.en: On clean and control test records the constraint verdicts report a violation in 0.074 of the checks (Figure 4 ), mostly on A2 and A5 (0.255 and 0.208 of their checks), where A2 evaluates the cruise lift coefficient at maximum take-off mass and A5 uses class-level latents; the report shows which relation the declared values strain and by how far (Figure 5 c), and the key and abduction rank the degrees without this rule.
blocks.zh: 关于清洁和控制测试记录,强制判决报告说,在检查(图4)的0.074中存在违反规定的情况,主要是A2和A5(检查结果的0.255和0.208),其中A2以最大起飞质量评价巡航升降系数,A5采用等级级潜伏;报告显示所申报的数值强度与幅度之间的关系(图5c),关键和绑架没有这一规则。

blocks.en: The largest degree, the largest-violation key, names the violated constraint in 0.942 of corrupted test records (generator labels; on each of 8 seeds), above Fellegi-Holt, Z3 and rule diagnosis (0.795 to 0.857; Figure 6 b); 49 to 85% of these margins come from the 16 test records that the crisp edits leave unflagged (key 0.812, chance 0.106), and on the 140 they flag it is on par with them. On the 81 test records with a single violated constraint the key reaches 0.963, above the class-standardized residual, a z-score of the same residuals, and MLP-SHAP, which are on par with it over all corrupted test records; it comes with a held or violated verdict against learned tolerances, the altered field with its repair and exact abstention under missing evidence, all read from NeSySpec’s own degrees, and the residual’s field ranking is below abduction (Section 4.3 ). On unseen families the key reaches 0.973 on each of 8 seeds, above Fellegi-Holt, Z3, MLP-SHAP and LightGBM-SHAP and on par with the class-standardized residual, with the rules at 0.863 (cells without an alternative-stream check; Appendix ), and on the unseen class 0.897 ± 0.007 0.897\pm 0.007 , above Fellegi-Holt, Z3, the rules and the class-standardized residual and on par with LightGBM-SHAP, with MLP-SHAP, a second model on the residuals, at 0.970 (Table ). On intervention labels without retraining, the key ranks first a constraint whose scope contains the altered field in 0.786 ± 0.006 0.786\pm 0.006 of corrupted test records (chance 0.232), above Fellegi-Holt, Z3 and rule diagnosis, with most of these margins from the 76 records that the crisp edits leave unflagged, and on par with LightGBM-SHAP, the strongest attribution on these labels; on unseen families NeSySpec’s second head, its secondary key, reaches 0.848 (largest-violation key 0.828; Appendix ). With the optional rank-then-explain setting, NeSySpec flags and correctly diagnoses 0.901 ± 0.013 0.901\pm 0.013 of corrupted test records and 0.849 ± 0.043 0.849\pm 0.043 on the unseen class (5 seed pairs), above Fellegi-Holt and Z3 behind the same alarm on test and on par with MLP-SHAP, with the violated constraint, the altered field and a repair from its own degrees; with its own alarm, the record verdict and the key reach 0.929 on test (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 最大程度,最大的违规键,将0.942中违反的制约(基因标签;在8个种子上方),超过Fellegi-Holt,Z3和规则诊断(0.795至0.857;图6b);这些边距的49至85%来自16个测试记录,即简洁编辑未加标记(键0.812,概率0.106),在140个测试记录上,它与它们相同。 在81份有单一违反约束的测试记录中,钥匙达到0.963, 高于类标准残留, 相同残留的Z分数, 和MLP-SHAP, 在所有腐烂的测试记录中, 在未发现的家庭,在Fellegi-Holt、Z3、MLP-SHAP和LightGBM-SHAP上方的8个种子中,每颗种子的钥匙达到0.973,与分类标准化的剩余量相当,规则为0.863(没有替代流检的细胞;附录),规则为0.897±0.007/pm0.007,在Fellegi-Holt、Z3、规则和分类标准化的剩余量为0.970(表)。 在没有再培训的干预标签方面,关键因素首先是限制,其范围包括0.786±0.06 0.786\pm 0.06中损坏的测试记录(chance 0.232),高于Fellegi-Holt、Z3和规则诊断,这些限制大多来自76项记录,简洁的编辑未加标记,与LightGBM-SHAP一样,这些标签上最强的归属;在看不见的家庭中,NeSySpec的第二个头部,其次要钥匙达到0.848(最大的违反键0.828;附录)。 NeSySpec旗在可选的等级设置下,正确诊断了0.901±0.013 0.901\pm 0.013 损坏的测试记录,并正确诊断了0.849±0.043 0.849\pm 0.043 隐形级(5个种子对),在测试时在Fellegi-Holt和Z3的同一警报后面和在与MLP-SHAP等同处,具有违反的制约,改变的球场和从自身程度修补;在测试时,它自己的警报,记录判断和键达到0.929 (附录).

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows the report of the first single-field corruption of the test split whose altered field an available constraint reads, chosen by a fixed rule. Its total thrust is altered: the report names A4, the thrust-to-weight ratio below the band learned from the fleet, as the largest violation, abduction finds the thrust, and changing the thrust alone brings V V below the decision threshold (0.181 against 0.310). A9, flagged by the oracle’s crisp band, is held, its thrust per engine inside the wider learned band; A5, which does not read the thrust, is violated as on the clean record (asterisk in panel b), so the repair, short of its stricter target, is a best-effort value to cross-check.
blocks.zh: 图5显示测试分裂的首次单场腐败报告,根据固定规则,该测试分裂的已改变的球场是可用的约束。 其总推力被改变:报告命名为A4,从舰队中吸取的波段下方的推力对重量比,因为最大的违反,绑架发现了推力,单改变推力就使得V V低于决定阈值(0.181对0.310). A9, 以神谕的脆带为标志, 它的推力在更广泛的学习带内; A5, 没有读取推力, 与干净记录一样被违反(在b面板中), 因此修复, 与其更严格的目标相比, 是交叉检查的最佳值 。

blocks.en: 4.3 Field Localization and Repair
blocks.zh: 4.3 实地定位和维修

blocks.en: Abduction names the altered field more often than minimum-cardinality localization on every split, on generated and on independently labeled errors, and needs no oracle to break ties (Figure 6 c). On single-field test corruptions (generator labels) it finds the altered field in 0.742 ± 0.011 0.742\pm 0.011 , above minimum-cardinality localization (0.367) and the Ochiai ranking of the class-standardized residuals; with the oracle tie-break, the setting most favorable to it, minimum-cardinality localization reaches 0.629, on par with abduction. On single-field records that no oracle selected or certified, abduction through the verifier fitted on generator labels, without retraining, finds the field moved beyond tolerance in 0.593 of test records, above minimum-cardinality localization (0.306) and its oracle tie-break (0.453); 78% of the margin over the oracle tie-break comes from the 70 records that the crisp edits leave unflagged, and on the 175 of 245 that they flag abduction stays above random tie-breaking and on par with the oracle tie-break. With the selected abduction rule (Appendix ), abduction is also ahead of the Class I sizing-regression residual, the field farthest from the conceptual-design (Class I) weight regressions on maximum take-off mass fitted on the training aircraft [ 71 ] , on test (0.597), on the unseen class (0.119) and on intervention labels (0.453, the level of the oracle tie-break as well), and on par with it on unseen families (0.693), with the violated constraint and a repair from the same verdict.
blocks.zh: 绑架所改变的字段的名称比最小的心动本地化在每次拆分,生成和单独标注的错误上更常见,不需要甲骨文来断开链接(图6 c). 在单场测试腐败(基因标签)中,发现改变的球场在0.742±0.011 0.742/pm0.011中,高于最低心力本地化(0.367)和阶级标准化残基的Ochiai排名;随着甲骨文结节破裂,最有利的设定,最小心力本地化达到0.629,与绑架相当. 在单场记录中,没有选定或认证的甲骨文,通过安装在生成器标签上的核查器进行绑架,没有再培训,发现在0.593份测试记录中,甲骨文在最小心力局部化(0.306)及其甲骨文领带断裂(0.453);在甲骨文领带断裂处的78%的比值来自70份记录,简洁编辑未加标记,在245年的175份记录中,甲骨文领带断裂处保留在随机领带断裂处,与甲骨文领带断裂处相同。 由于有选择的绑架规则(附录),绑架也高于I级分解-后退残余,现场距离训练飞机[71]、试验(0.597)、隐形舱(0.119)和干预标签(0.453、甲骨节断层)所装的最大起飞量(I级)概念设计重量下降最远,与未见家属相同(0.693),违反了限制规定,并修正了同一判决。

blocks.en: The repair proposal of Eq. ( 13 ) comes from NeSySpec’s own abduction and verdict, with the field and the violated constraint in the same report. It cuts the log-space error on the altered field from 0.366 to 0.133 and on the whole record to 0.200, and is closer on the record than the Fellegi-Holt, MaxSMT, nearest-neighbor and regression repairs and on the altered field than a constraint-layer repair ordering in the style of PiShield [ 47 ] ; at the field of the Class I residual, MICE [ 83 ] (0.120 and 0.161) and missForest are on par with it on both errors, as is the regression on the altered field (Table ). The solver reaches its target, a verdict V ≤ − ln ⁡ 0.9 ≈ 0.1054 V\leq-\ln 0.9\approx 0.1054 stricter than the decision threshold, on 0.555 of the single-field test records and otherwise returns its best-effort value (Figure 5 c); the report issues a proposal for each flagged record, as a value to cross-check.
blocks.zh: Eq.(13)的修复建议来自NeSySpec自己的绑架和判决,现场和同一报告中违反的限制。 它将已改变的字段的对数空间误差从0.366减少到0.133,并在全记录中减少到0.20,在记录上比Fellegi-Holt、MaxSMT、最近的邻居和回归修复以及已改变的字段更接近于Pishield[47]风格的制约层修复命令;在I类剩余字段,MICE[83](0.120和0.161)和Forest小姐在两个错误上都与它一致,在改变的字段的回归(表)也是如此。 解答者达到了目标,在单场测试记录的0.555上,在0.9 + 0.1054 V\leq-\in 0.9\\ 01054上,比决定阈值更严格,否则将返回其最佳值(图5c);报告为每个标注记录发出一个建议,作为交叉检查的值。

blocks.en: 4.4 Record Coherence
blocks.zh: 4.4 记录一致性

blocks.en: On generator labels, with 16 test aircraft of 9 families held out of training, the record verdict tells coherent from incoherent records at a test AUROC of 0.979 ± 0.002 0.979\pm 0.002 , above learners on the raw fields (0.748 to 0.792), and each of its flags arrives with the violated constraint, the altered field and a repair proposal, read from the degrees of Figure 4 . In distribution TabPFN v2 is on par with it and the other learners on the residuals are close to it, the residual MLP at 0.990 ± 0.003 0.990\pm 0.003 and TabPFN v2, LightGBM and the one-class SVM at 0.957 to 0.958 (Appendix ). At a TPR of 0.90 the record verdict’s false alarms on the 32 controls (0.086) are fewer than those of the Mahalanobis distance (0.656), each naming the constraint that raised it (Table ).
blocks.zh: 在发电机的标签上,有16架9个家庭的试验飞机被扣在培训之外,记录判断从AUROC测试时的不连贯记录中可以看出,在生田(0.748至0.792)上方的学习者,其每一面旗帜都带有违反的制约、改变的场面和从图4的度看的修理建议。 在分布 TabPFN v2 与它相当,其余部分的其他学习者与之接近,剩余 MLP 0.990±0.003 0.990\pm 0.003 和 TabPFN v2, LightGBM 和 单级 SVM 0.957– 0.958 (附录 ). 在0.90的TPR中,记录判决对32个控制(0.086)的虚假警报比Mahalanobis距离(0.656)的警报要少,每一次都点出引起这种警报的制约(表)。

blocks.en: On the unseen class of business jets, the key and abduction lead classical diagnosis and minimum-cardinality localization (Sections 4.2 and 4.3 ). In detection there the record verdict reaches 0.934 and five learners on the residuals rank higher (residual MLP 0.978, TabPFN v2 up to 0.984), and NeSySpec’s optional rank-then-explain setting lets the residual MLP raise the alarm and NeSySpec explain it, with false alarms on 0.205 of the 38 controls and 0.168 of the 19 pristine records at validation thresholds. On intervention labels, whose altered single fields move beyond the tolerance, by up to 80%, the key and abduction lead the classical comparators without retraining (Sections 4.2 and 4.3 ); in detection there, the residual MLP retrained on these labels and TabPFN v2, whose statistics include the scored rows, rank test records higher (Table ).
blocks.zh: 在看不见的商用喷气式飞机中,钥匙和绑架导致古典诊断和最低心率本地化(第4.2和4.3节)。 在现场检测中,记录判决达到0.934,其余的5名学员排名较高(剩余MLP 0.978,TabPFN v2至0.984),而NeSySpec的可选级级表设置让剩余MLP提高警报,NeSySpec对此作出解释,38个控制器中的0.205个和19个原始记录中的0.168个在验证阈值时有虚假警报。 在干预标签上,经过改变的单个字段超过容忍度,键盘和绑架高达80%,导致古典参照物没有再培训(第4.2节和4.3节);在那里检测时,这些标签和TabPFN v2上的剩余MLP重新训练,其统计包括得分排数,等级测试记录较高(表)。

blocks.en: With a paired image, NeSySpec also checks the record against the image and names the cross-modal axiom that the image contradicts (Section 3.4 ). On satellite pairs, the multimodal verifier of Eq. ( 10 ) achieves an AUROC of 0.994 ± 0.002 0.994\pm 0.002 over all pair types with a ConvNeXt-T backbone [ 90 ] (8 seeds). Qwen3-VL-8B [ 53 ] , prompted with rules R1-R10, reaches 0.748; the verifier’s advantage holds across all evaluated backbones.
blocks.zh: NeSySpec还用一对图像来对照图像检查记录,并命名图像与之相矛盾的跨模式轴(第3.4节)。 在卫星配对上,Eq.(10)的多式验证器在所有配对类型上均实现了0.994±0.002 0.994\pm 0.002的AUROC,具有ConvNEXt-T主干线[90](8种子). Qune3-VL-8B [53],以规则R1-R10为动机,达到0.748;核查员的优势存在于所有被评价的骨干中.

blocks.en: With ResNet-50 used for both, the verifier also outperforms end-to-end fusions trained on labeled pairs on test and unseen sites. Some learned fusions achieve higher AUROC on image swaps and unseen-site pairs. Without an image, the verifier returns the record verdict bit for bit. Appendix details the comparison protocols and their asymmetries. On photographs the cross-modal stratum is on par with Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3-VL-32B prompted with the same axioms on test (0.692 against 0.668 and 0.712) and prints the part map of its evidence beside the contradicted cross-modal axiom; on the families held out of NeSySpec’s training, most of which the 32-billion-parameter model names from the photograph alone, that model reaches 0.827 and the stratum 0.733. This advantage may partly reflect the visual and semantic priors acquired through extensive multimodal pretraining [ 53 ] . These families are held out from our task-specific training; pretraining exposure is not controlled across the compared systems. Further comparisons should distinguish prior recognition from reasoning over the supplied physical constraints.
blocks.zh: 由于ResNet-50既用于两者,核查者也超越了在试验和隐蔽地点接受标签配对培训的端到端聚变。 一些学习的聚变在图像互换和隐形点对上实现更高的AUROC. 没有图像, 校验者会将记录判定位返回到比特. 附录详细介绍了比较协议及其不对称性. 在照片上,跨模式图层与Qune3-VL-8B和Qune3-VL-32B一样,在测试时用相同的轴线(0.692对0.668和0.712)发出,并在相互矛盾的跨模式轴线旁打印出其证据的部分地图;在NeSySpec训练中被扣住的家属,其中多数是照片上320亿参数的模型名称,该模型达到0.827和层0.733。 这一优势可能部分反映了通过广泛的多式联运预训获得的视觉和语义学前科[53]。 这些家庭被排斥在针对具体任务的培训之外;在比较系统中,培训前的接触不受控制。 进一步比较应区分事先确认和对所提供物理限制的推理。

blocks.en: When a head asserts an attribute, the grounding axiom encourages it to place its evidence on the corresponding part. The Reichenbach gate scales this soft penalty with the strength of the head’s assertion, without using attribute labels. The report then displays the evidence map for inspection.

blocks.en: We compare methods using per-example penalties, keeping the batch’s normalization constants fixed and stopping gradients through those statistics. Loss weights are selected on validation using one seed per candidate value (Appendix ). Under this common protocol, the network trained with the grounding axiom localizes the annotated parts substantially better than RRR [ 57 ] and GradMask [ 58 ] . [ 61 ] , run both with the calibration of the protocol, which flattened their teacher toward the uniform prediction, and with a recalibrated arm, lies above zero on the FGVC pseudo-masks and on the human part masks of PASCAL-Part, PartImageNet [ 85 ] and UDA-Part [ 86 ] (Appendix ). At that budget the record verdict is also evaded less often than TabPFN v2, the one-class SVM, LightGBM on the raw fields and an isolation forest, while the share of its flagged bare lies beyond cover is 0.247, against 0.494 and 0.325 for the rules with hierarchical pooling and a Mahalanobis distance on the declared fields, whose minimal covers take more edits (3.62 and 3.45); each of its flags comes with the field found by abduction and a repair proposal. NeSySpec’s optional critical-field alert addresses this channel, and each of its flags names the undeclared critical field or the violated constraint: against an attacker who knows the alert and withholds up to two fields, 0.729 of lies pass NeSySpec with the alert, on par with the residual MLP given the same alert (0.756) with all splits pooled. With the alert, false alarms on the 32 test controls are 0.148, below the Mahalanobis distance (0.656).

blocks.en: 4.8 What the Logic Adds: Other Encodings of the Same Knowledge
blocks.zh: 4.8 (中文(简体) ). 逻辑加法:相同知识的其他编码

blocks.en:
The logical formulation provides the constraint-level verdicts used for diagnosis and repair. For record-level detection, learners on the same residuals perform similarly to NeSySpec in distribution and better on the unseen class (Section 4.4 ). Against the network trained with the DL2 loss on the same residuals and targets, which learns one head per constraint in place of the graded predicates and is their like-for-like test, NeSySpec’s graded predicates trained through Real Logic give constraint verdicts with a higher macro-F1 and a better key, with the field and a repair from the same degrees (Section 4.2 ). Of the other Real Logic properties of Section 2.1 , guarded quantification gives the exact abstention that none of 207 learned method and cell rows keeps without an image (Section 4.5 ), the shared truth scale the fused verdict (Section 4.4 ) and the gate grounding stable across loss weights (Section 4.6 ). Stratification (E4) keeps one verdict per evidence source, so the report says whether the record or the image raised the flag (Appendix ). Training the knowledge base through the differentiable truths of Real Logic improves detection over keeping it at its initial values: AUROC rises from 0.907 to 0.979 on test and from 0.845 to 0.934 on the unseen class.
On generator labels, the full model outperforms the flat-bank ablation on every split. Removing in-band grading lowers detection on the unseen class and slightly on test and unseen families. The ablation using a generalized mean at p = 4 p=4 is on par with the full model (Table ). In detection on test the record verdict (0.979) is slightly above the DL2-loss network (0.965) and a per-constraint monotone model on the same residual magnitudes without LTN (0.966), and on par with the network out of distribution; NeSySpec reads these magnitudes as graded predicates in physical units (Figure 5 c), with the key, abduction and repair from the same degrees. The generator’s per-constraint targets (Section 4.2 ) and the graded predicates act together: the ablation trained with the binary record label only equals the generator labels in 0.081 of test records and is below the crisp edits on all three measures. Given as a constraint loss on the declared fields or as rules in words, the same knowledge detects less than NeSySpec’s verdict: the DL2 method on the declared fields reaches 0.703 ± 0.030 0.703\pm 0.030 and a language model prompted with the constraints A1-A11 in words (Qwen3-8B [ 52 ] , anonymized records) 0.620, below the record verdict on every split (Table ), and both are below its key and verdicts (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
逻辑公式提供了用于诊断和修复的制约级判断. 为了进行记录级检测,同一残基上的学习者在分布上表现与NeSySpec相似,在看不见的班级上表现更好(第4.4节)。 NeSySpec通过Real Logic培训的具有DL2损失的网络在相同的剩余部分和目标上学习了每条约束线一个头,取代了分级的上游线,这是他们相似的测试,NeSySpec的分级上游线通过Real Logic进行约束性判断,其宏观F1和键值较高,现场和修补程度相同(第4.2节)。 在2.1节的其他真实逻辑属性中,谨慎的量化给出了207个学过的方法和单元格行中没有一个保持没有图像的准确弃权(4.5节),共享的真相将引信判断(4.4节)和在损失重量之间固定的大门(4.6节)。 分级(E4)保留每个证据来源一个判断,因此报告提到是记录还是图像升起旗帜(附录). 通过真实逻辑的不同真理对知识基础进行培训,改进了检测,而不是保持初始值:在测试中,AUROC从0.907上升到0.979,在看不见的班级中从0.845上升到0.934。
在生成器标签上,整个模型的性能超过了每分块上的扁平-银行膨胀. 取消带内分级会降低在看不见的班级上的检测,在测试和看不见的家庭上略微降低检测。 使用p = 4 p = 4 的通用平均值的减值与整个模型相同(表)。 在测试中检测到,记录判断(0.979)略高于DL2-损失网络(0.965)和没有LTN(0.966)的相同残留量级的每块受约束单酮模型,与网络的分布相当;NeSySpec在物理单元(图5c)中将这些量级读作分级的上游,其键,绑架和修复程度相同. 发电机的每个约束目标(第4.2节)和分级的上游一起行动:用二进制记录标签训练的衰竭只等于0.081测试记录中的发电机标签,低于所有三项措施的简洁编辑。 鉴于申报字段的制约性损失或文字规则,同一知识检测不到NeSySpec的判决:申报字段的DL2方法达到0.703±0.030 0.703\pm 0.030,语言模型在字段(Qune3-8B [52],匿名记录)的A1-A11的限制下为0.620, 低于每分部分的记录判决(表),两者都低于其关键和判决(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: Figure 9 traces the training of the axioms over eight seeds per stratum. For the specification axioms, a re-run of NeSySpec’s training whose only addition is a copy of the state at each epoch reproduces every frozen checkpoint and its predictions bit for bit, together with every logged loss and validation AUROC; each state is scored at the end of its epoch on the training and validation records. From the initial state, shared by all seeds, to the restored best epoch, the mean feasibility exp ⁡ ( − V ) \exp(-V) on validation rises from 0.734 to 0.930 on clean-labeled records and falls from 0.335 to 0.151 on corrupted ones, while the verdict’s validation AUROC rises from 0.901 to 0.997. Panel b averages each axiom’s truth exp ⁡ ( − v k ) \exp(-v_{k}) , which the constraint verdicts compare with 0.5, over the records where the axiom is available; the feasibility of Eq. ( 9 ) in panel a is the geometric mean of a record’s available truths. The satisfaction of the grounding axioms, averaged over the training batches of each epoch while the weights move, rises from 0.816 at the first epoch to 0.936 at the restored best epoch on photographs and from 0.976 to 0.999 on satellite crops. The training logs of the remote-sensing axioms hold no per-axiom truth, so panel c shows their verdict’s validation AUROC beside the photographs’ head accuracy and pointing; the cross-modal axioms have no trainable parameter, and late epochs average fewer seeds where early stopping ended a run.

Removing one constraint (panel c) lowers detection for A5, the Breguet range, and A2, the cruise lift coefficient, and slightly for A4, A7 and A8, the thrust-to-weight, mass-balance and empty-weight-fraction checks, and raises it for none; it also lowers abduction for 7 of the 12 constraints and slightly for 3 more (Appendix ).

blocks.en: 4.10 Limitations

Each limitation is bounded by the protocol and opens a line of future work (Section 5 ). Domain and use. NeSySpec is validated on aircraft, whose public civil records and relations a reader can verify; only its knowledge base, visual predicates, corruption generator and data are domain-specific (Appendix A ), and its verdicts support a human analyst, with aircraft detection, tracking and identification outside its scope because of the dual-use risks of such capabilities [ 93 ] . Synthetic errors and scale. Every error is generated or edited, so its type, magnitude and field are known and each verdict is checked against them, and the intervention labels are independent of the generator; they mark the constraints an edit involves, about a third of the altered rows break none of them physically, and expert per-constraint physical labels will score the verdicts against violations (Section 5 ); the 107 aircraft and one published split hold every test family and satellite site out of training. Naturally occurring errors, expert red teams, larger fleets and a replication on a new fleet will extend this evidence. Class-level relations. A2 evaluates the cruise lift coefficient at maximum take-off mass and A5 uses latents shared by a class and engine type, estimable from 44 training aircraft; most violations reported on clean records come from these two relations (Section 4.2 ), which per-type latents and a cruise-weight form of A2 will refine. Classes without training aircraft. There, residual learners rank higher in record-level detection (Section 4.4 ); the optional rank-then-explain setting lets such a learner raise the alarm while NeSySpec names the constraint, the field and a repair, and larger fleets will reduce the classes read with fleet statistics alone. Omission. A withheld field masks the axioms that read it, the exact abstention of Proposition 1 ; the optional critical-field alert flags the omission, and class-level axioms will make the omission of a critical field a violation. Masks, statistics and encodings. Automatic pseudo-masks supervise the grounding axiom, so the protocol is reproducible from public data, and hand-annotated part masks will extend it; no multiplicity correction is applied, which the new-fleet replication will address; encoding the knowledge base in DeepProbLog, Scallop or PSL, with probabilistic facts and proofs, changes its axiomatic and logical structure and is left to a dedicated comparison.
