blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Future Works
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和未来工程

blocks.en: NeSySpec is an integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic framework for auditing engineering specifications: its graded axioms on Logic Tensor Networks, trained on fleet data, determine which physical constraints a declared specification respects and which it violates, and from the degree behind each verdict it derives the altered field, a repair proposal, exact abstention on missing evidence, part-grounded image evidence and a verification report. Validated on 107 aircraft with generated, intervention-labeled and falsified errors, it provides and evaluates these outputs together.
blocks.zh: NeSySpec是用于审计工程规格的一个综合和可解释的神经-符号框架:它在逻辑天线网络上分级的轴线,经过车队数据培训,确定所申报的规格尊重哪些物理约束以及它违反哪些功能,并从每个判决背后得到改变的字段、修理提案、对缺失证据的确切弃权、部分根据的图像证据和核查报告。 它在107架飞机上验证了产生、干预、标记和伪造的错误,提供和评价这些产出。

blocks.en: Using a fixed rule to classify each constraint as held or violated, NeSySpec reaches a test macro-F1 of 0.795 with generator labels and, without retraining, 0.575 with intervention labels. On every split evaluated with generator labels, it outperforms three comparators in macro-F1: a network trained with the DL2 loss on the same residuals; DL2 applied to the declared fields; and a language model given the constraints in words.
blocks.zh: NeSySpec使用固定规则将每个约束归类为持有或违反,使用生成器标签的测试宏-F1达到0.795,没有再培训,0.575使用干预标签. 在每次使用生成器标签进行分拆时,它在宏-F1中表现优于3个参照方:一个在相同残基上经过DL2损失培训的网络;DL2应用于已申报的字段;以及一个语言模型,因为字数有限制.

blocks.en: The largest-violation key identifies the violated constraint in 0.942 of corrupted test records with generator labels, outperforming Fellegi–Holt, solver-based diagnosis and rule-based diagnosis. On independently labeled errors, abduction identifies the altered field in 0.593 of records without retraining. Minimum-cardinality localization reaches 0.306 with random tie-breaking and 0.453 with oracle tie-breaking. The Class I sizing-regression residual also reaches 0.453. The record verdict detects incoherent records at a test AUROC of 0.979 on generator labels, and a missing field or image leaves each verdict exactly that of the available constraints.
blocks.zh: 最大违规键识别了0.942中违反的带有生成器标签的腐败测试记录,表现优于Fellegi-Holt,基于解答器的诊断和基于规则的诊断. 在独立标记的错误上,绑架在未经再培训的0.593项记录中指明了被改变的领域。 最小心肌局部化达到0.306分,随机断带,0.453分,甲骨文断带. 一级测距-后退残留也达到0.453。 记录判决在对生成器标签的AUROC为0.979的测试中检测出不一致的记录,一个缺失的字段或图像会给每个判决留下准确的现有限制.

blocks.en: An image lets the audit check the declared record against visible attributes and identify the axiom behind a disagreement. On satellite pairs, the multimodal verifier achieves an AUROC of 0.994 across all pair types, compared with 0.748 for a prompted vision-language model.
blocks.zh: 图像可以让审计对照可见属性检查已声明的记录,并识别分歧背后的轴线. 在卫星对子上,多式联运核查器在所有对子类型中实现0.994的AUROC,而激发视觉语言模型则达到0.748。

blocks.en: The report also shows where each visual head places its evidence. With the grounding axiom, these maps point to the annotated part in 0.737 of PASCAL-Part human masks. Localization is substantially better than RRR and GradMask on human masks from PASCAL-Part, PartImageNet and UDA-Part, with wider intervals on the 40 UDA-Part items (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 该报告还显示每个视觉头部将其证据放置在何处。 这些地图显示的是PASCAL-Part人体面具0.737中的注解部分。 本地化大大优于PASCAL-Part、PartImageNet和UDA-Part的人体口罩上的RRR和GradMask,40个UDA-Part项目的间隔更广(附录)。

blocks.en: Among the approaches evaluated here (the DL2 method on the declared fields, the network trained with the DL2 loss on the same residuals read per constraint, a constraint-layer repair ordering, LTN ablations, solver and rule diagnosis and prompted language and vision-language models), NeSySpec is, to our knowledge, the most suitable neuro-symbolic framework for auditing engineering specifications: it provides and evaluates together the outputs of Table 2 , and its key and abduction lead classical diagnosis, the DL2 method, a prompted language model and minimum-cardinality localization with random tie-breaking. No comparator returns all the outputs of the audit, and on the test aircraft none is ahead of NeSySpec in the macro-F1 of the constraint verdicts, in naming the violated constraint and the altered field or in the repair error on the altered field (Table 5 ). With oracles fitted without test or out-of-distribution aircraft, its leads on intervention labels over Fellegi-Holt and Z3 in diagnosis and over minimum-cardinality localization with random tie-breaking hold on every split, at lower levels (Section 4.1 ). Its logic serves the physical audit more than record classification: in record-level detection, learners on the same residuals are close to it and in some settings rank records higher (Section 4.4 ). Its detection grows with the knowledge it encodes, following the share of edits that alter a field its constraints read, with diminishing returns in their number.
blocks.zh: 在本文所评价的方法中(DL2方法在申报的字段上、通过DL2损失在相同残片上读取的网络、限制级修复命令、LTN冲洗、解析器和规则诊断以及诱发语言和视觉语言模型),据我们所知,NeSySpec是审计工程规格的最合适的神经系统框架:它提供并共同评估表2的输出结果、其关键和绑架引领经典诊断、DL2方法、诱导语言模型和最小心力定位以及随机断结。 没有参照国返回审计的所有产出,在限制判决的宏观-F1中,在指定被违反的制约和被改变的字段或被改变的字段的修复错误中,在测试飞机上,没有一个比NeSySpec更早(表5)。 使用未经试验或分配外飞机安装的甲骨文,在Fellegi-Holt和Z3上空的干预标签上,在诊断和最小心力局部化方面,在下一级,在每一分点上,随机断结(第4.1节)。 它的逻辑服务于实际审计而不是记录分类:在记录级别检测中,学习者在相同剩余部分上接近它,在一些环境中排名较高(第4.4节)。 它的探测随着它编码的知识而增长,随着编辑部分改变一个字段其读取的限制,其数目的回报逐渐减少。

blocks.en:
This study is a first approach to specification auditing, evaluated on aircraft and constructed errors. Broader physical knowledge, richer input evidence and larger, more diverse datasets may improve generalization to unseen systems, to be tested through independent replications. The logical formulation helps interpret anomalies by exposing which relations fail and which fields are implicated.
Future work will extend NeSySpec along the following directions: • Other neuro-symbolic encodings. A version of the knowledge base in DeepProbLog, Scallop and PSL, with probabilistic facts and proofs in place of graded truths and masked quantification, will be compared with NeSySpec, together with the semantic loss and the monotone model read per constraint. • Aircraft-level latents and refined relations. Per-type latents in A5 and a cruise-weight formulation of A2 will refine the constraint verdicts. Per-constraint thresholds selected on validation will calibrate these verdicts, and expert physical labels for each constraint will be used to evaluate them. The report will display every learned band in physical units. A new relation involving the ceiling will cover the only declared field not currently checked by any constraint. Additional relations can improve detection by checking different physical relationships among fields already covered elsewhere, as A2 does. • Other engineering applications. Visual recognition of components and geometry could extend the audit to mechanical assemblies, industrial equipment and civil structures, with adapted knowledge bases, visual predicates and corruption generators. • Poorly characterized observations. The framework could also support the analysis of observations whose identity or physical behaviour remains uncertain. Physical constraints could help compare candidate explanations and identify the additional measurements needed to distinguish them. • Generative design and simulation. Exporting structured parameter vectors, units and constraints could connect the audit to agentic pipelines that generate parametric CAD models from text and images. Candidate models could then undergo finite element method (FEM) simulations, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and other numerical analyses, feeding their results back into the audit. • Training and hyperparameters. Further ablations will assess how supervision, loss balancing and joint versus separate module training affect diagnosis and generalization. Hyperparameter sensitivity will be evaluated on validation data. • Inference efficiency. Profiling will measure the inference cost of each module. Batching, caching and adaptive search budgets will be evaluated in terms of latency, diagnostic accuracy and repair quality. • Naturally occurring errors. Cross-source discrepancies, variant mix-ups, with block abduction, and uncorroborated fields will bring the audit to real errors, and expert red teams will extend the falsification protocol. • Evidence, images and declarations. Imputation channels chosen with block-wise hiding will extend NeSySpec with MICE imputation enabled, hand-annotated FGVC-Aircraft part masks and visual strata adapted to new sensors will extend the grounding axiom, and class-level axioms will make the omission of a critical field a violation.
blocks.zh:
这项研究是进行规格审计、对飞机进行评价和制造错误的第一个办法。 更广泛的物理知识、更丰富的输入证据和更大的、更多样化的数据集可改进对无形系统的概括化,通过独立复制进行测试。 逻辑表达法通过揭示哪些关系失败以及涉及哪些领域来帮助解释异常.
今后的工作将沿着以下方向扩展NeSySpec: • 其他神经-连锁编码. 在DeepProbLog,Scayop和PSL的一个版本的知识库,以概率性事实和证明代替分级的真理和蒙面量化,将和NeSySpec进行比较,同时将语义损失和单酮模型读作每个约束. • 飞机一级的潜在作用和完善的关系。 A5中的单型潜伏物和A2的巡航重量配方将完善约束性判断. 在验证时选择的受约束阈值将校准这些判决,并且将使用每个约束的专家物理标签来评价它们. 报告将以物理单位显示每一个学习的乐队. 涉及上限的新关系将涵盖目前没有受到任何限制限制的唯一已申报的领域。 与A2一样,通过检查已在别处覆盖的字段之间的不同物理关系,其他关系可以改善检测。 • 其他工程应用。 对组件和几何的视觉识别可以将审计扩大到机械组件、工业设备和民用结构,并配有适应性的知识库、视觉上游和腐败发生器。 • 观察特征不佳。 该框架还可以支持对身份或身体行为仍然不确定的观测的分析。 物理限制可有助于比较候选人的解释,并确定区分这些解释所需的额外衡量标准。 • 基因设计和模拟。 输出结构化参数矢量,单位和制约可以将审计与代理管道连接起来,通过文本和图像生成参数CAD模型. 然后,候选人模型可以进行有限要素方法模拟、计算流体动力学(CFD)和其他数字分析,并将结果反馈给审计。 • 培训和超参数。 还将评估监督、损失平衡和联合培训与单独模块培训如何影响诊断和概括。 将在验证数据上评价超参数灵敏度。 • 推论效率。 分析将衡量每个单元的推论费用。 将根据耐久性、诊断准确性和修复质量来评估抽查、缓存和适应性搜索预算。 • 自然发生的错误。 跨源差异,变体混杂,与块绑架,以及未经证实的字段,将使审计出现真实错误,专家红色团队将延长伪造协议. • 证据、图像和声明。 以块形隐藏方式选择的截图通道将延长NeSySpec,允许MICE估算,手动附加说明的FGVC-Aircraft部分口罩和适应新传感器的视觉层将延长搁浅轴线,而类级轴线将使关键字段的省略成为侵权.

blocks.en: Aircraft-level latents and refined relations. Per-type latents in A5 and a cruise-weight formulation of A2 will refine the constraint verdicts. Per-constraint thresholds selected on validation will calibrate these verdicts, and expert physical labels for each constraint will be used to evaluate them. The report will display every learned band in physical units. A new relation involving the ceiling will cover the only declared field not currently checked by any constraint. Additional relations can improve detection by checking different physical relationships among fields already covered elsewhere, as A2 does.
blocks.zh: 飞机一级潜伏和完善的关系。 A5中的单型潜伏物和A2的巡航重量配方将完善约束性判断. 在验证时选择的受约束阈值将校准这些判决,并且将使用每个约束的专家物理标签来评价它们. 报告将以物理单位显示每一个学习的乐队. 涉及上限的新关系将涵盖目前没有受到任何限制限制的唯一已申报的领域。 与A2一样,通过检查已在别处覆盖的字段之间的不同物理关系,其他关系可以改善检测。

blocks.en: Other engineering applications. Visual recognition of components and geometry could extend the audit to mechanical assemblies, industrial equipment and civil structures, with adapted knowledge bases, visual predicates and corruption generators.
blocks.zh: 其他工程应用. 对组件和几何的视觉识别可以将审计扩大到机械组件、工业设备和民用结构,并配有适应性的知识库、视觉上游和腐败发生器。

blocks.en: Poorly characterized observations. The framework could also support the analysis of observations whose identity or physical behaviour remains uncertain. Physical constraints could help compare candidate explanations and identify the additional measurements needed to distinguish them.
blocks.zh: 特征差的观察。 该框架还可以支持对身份或身体行为仍然不确定的观测的分析。 物理限制可有助于比较候选人的解释,并确定区分这些解释所需的额外衡量标准。

blocks.en: Generative design and simulation. Exporting structured parameter vectors, units and constraints could connect the audit to agentic pipelines that generate parametric CAD models from text and images. Candidate models could then undergo finite element method (FEM) simulations, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and other numerical analyses, feeding their results back into the audit.
blocks.zh: 基因设计和模拟. 输出结构化参数矢量,单位和制约可以将审计与代理管道连接起来,通过文本和图像生成参数CAD模型. 然后,候选人模型可以进行有限要素方法模拟、计算流体动力学(CFD)和其他数字分析,并将结果反馈给审计。

blocks.en: Training and hyperparameters. Further ablations will assess how supervision, loss balancing and joint versus separate module training affect diagnosis and generalization. Hyperparameter sensitivity will be evaluated on validation data.
blocks.zh: 训练和超参数。 还将评估监督、损失平衡和联合培训与单独模块培训如何影响诊断和概括。 将在验证数据上评价超参数灵敏度。

blocks.en: Inference efficiency. Profiling will measure the inference cost of each module. Batching, caching and adaptive search budgets will be evaluated in terms of latency, diagnostic accuracy and repair quality.
blocks.zh: 推论效率. 分析将衡量每个单元的推论费用。 将根据耐久性、诊断准确性和修复质量来评估抽查、缓存和适应性搜索预算。

blocks.en: Naturally occurring errors. Cross-source discrepancies, variant mix-ups, with block abduction, and uncorroborated fields will bring the audit to real errors, and expert red teams will extend the falsification protocol.
blocks.zh: 自然发生的错误。 跨源差异,变体混杂,与块绑架,以及未经证实的字段,将使审计出现真实错误,专家红色团队将延长伪造协议.

blocks.en: Evidence, images and declarations. Imputation channels chosen with block-wise hiding will extend NeSySpec with MICE imputation enabled, hand-annotated FGVC-Aircraft part masks and visual strata adapted to new sensors will extend the grounding axiom, and class-level axioms will make the omission of a critical field a violation.
blocks.zh: 证据、图像和声明。 以块形隐藏方式选择的截图通道将延长NeSySpec,允许MICE估算,手动附加说明的FGVC-Aircraft部分口罩和适应新传感器的视觉层将延长搁浅轴线,而类级轴线将使关键字段的省略成为侵权.

blocks.en: The aircraft study suggests this ordered checklist. 1. Scope. NeSySpec audits the coherence of a declaration with physics and with its evidence, and its report supports human review (Section ). 2. Fields and relations. List the fields with their units and one relation per constraint, and let every constraint that reads an undeclared field abstain: on the records as declared, filling the undeclared fields at scoring lowers detection, with global means on every split and with MICE on test and unseen families, while with fields hidden at random MICE at scoring ranks unseen-family records higher (Appendix G.3 ). 3. Priors and labels. Fit initial bands on clean training records only, and fix an intervention tolerance before generation, so that the intervention labels also reach errors that the generator oracle misses: on aircraft, the oracle flags no constraint on 613 of the 1,810 rows labeled as altered (33.9%; Appendix G.4 ). 4. Masks and sensors. Measure automatic part masks against public human masks, and train visual heads on images of the sensor in use (Sections and ; Appendix G.5 ). 5. Comparators. Include learners on the same physical residuals: on aircraft records a multilayer perceptron on them serves as the alarm of the optional rank-then-explain setting (Section ). 6. Critical fields. NeSySpec abstains on every constraint that reads an undeclared field; on aircraft, NeSySpec’s optional critical-field alert brings the evasion of lies that withhold fields back to the level of bare lies, which withhold none (Section ).
blocks.zh: 飞机研究提出这份订购清单。 1. 范围. NeSySpec审计申报与物理及其证据的一致性及其报告支持人类审查(第......节)。 2. 领域和关系。 列出每个限制的单位和一个关系,并让每个限制读取一个未申报的字段时都弃权:在所申报的记录中填充未申报的字段,在分数下检测时填充全局手段,在每分数上填充MICE,在测试和隐蔽的家族上填充全局手段,同时在MICE随机隐藏在分数下——家族记录较高(附录G.3). 3. 前科和标签。 将初始带只装在干净的训练记录上,并在一代人之前固定干预耐受性,从而使干预标签也达到生成者甲骨文所忽略的错误:在飞机上,甲骨文旗对标注为更改的1,810行中的613行没有约束(33.9%;附录G.4). 4. 面具和传感器。 对公共人体口罩进行自动部分口罩测量,并对正在使用的传感器图像进行视觉头部培训(节和;附录G.5)。 5. 比较者。 将学习者包括在同一物理残存物上:在飞机上记录一个多层感应器,作为可选的军衔和解释设置的警报(第......节)。 6. 关键领域。 NeSySpec对读取未申报的字段的每个限制都投弃权票;在飞机上,NeSySpec的可选关键字段警报将逃避扣下字段的谎言带回赤裸的谎言水平,而赤裸的谎言则没有扣下(第2节).

blocks.en:
This appendix summarizes how the implementation of NeSySpec is organized and shows an example of a verification report.
The implementation follows the seven modules of Section . Every prediction file, of NeSySpec and of each comparator, has one format (instance identifier, split and score, with per-constraint outputs where the method returns them), so a single evaluation script scores every method in the same way.
blocks.zh:
本附录概述了NeSySpec的实施安排,并举例说明了核查报告。
执行时遵循第3款的七个单元。 每个预测文件,即NeSySpec和每个比较者的文件,都有一种格式(内置标识符,拆分和分数,在方法返回时按约束输出),所以一个单一的评价脚本以同样的方式对每个方法进行分数.

blocks.en: B.1 Example of a Verification Report
blocks.zh: B.1 核查报告实例

blocks.en:
Figure (Section ) shows a report assembled from the saved outputs of NeSySpec (train prior, seed 0) for a record chosen by a rule fixed before any value was read: the first single-field corruption of the test split, in file order, whose altered field an available constraint reads.
The corruption divides the total thrust of a narrow-body turbofan by 1.2, and the generator oracle flags A4 and A9. The verdict flags the record ( V = 1.217 V=1.217 , above the validation threshold t ⋆ = 0.310 t^{\star}=0.310 of this seed), and the report lists the degree of every available constraint, the largest being A4 (10.001), A5 (1.053), A8 (0.386) and A9 (0.384). By the rule of Section , A4 and A5 exceed ln ⁡ 2 \ln 2 and are violated, A5 also on the clean record, while A8 and A9 are held. The largest-violation key names A4, which the oracle flags; it ranks A4 first in every seed, followed by A5 in this seed and by A8 in 5 of the 8 seeds.

blocks.en:
The specification axioms evaluate closed-form relations of conceptual aircraft design [ 71 ] (Table ).
Table C.1 gives the constants of the relations and of the International Standard Atmosphere (ISO 2533:1975) with the initial values of the graded degrees, and Table C.2 the remote-sensing constants with the Airplane Design Groups of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) 3 3 3 FAA Advisory Circular 150/5300-13B, Airport Design, March 31, 2022. .
The train prior widens each per-class range of a derived quantity over the 44 clean training aircraft to [ 0.88 ​ min , 1.12 ​ max ] [0.88\min,\,1.12\max] , as the oracle does; these initial bands are then learned with their slopes (Section ), and business jets, absent from training, start from the band of all training classes. The learned bands act as tolerances learned from the fleet. On specification records, 45.7% of them keep both edges inside the training fleet range widened in the same way, and the others extend beyond it (Appendix G.9 ). In the remote-sensing stratum, 103 of the 144 learned group bands (the 18 bands of R2 for military roles, R3 and R4 in each of the 8 seeds) extend beyond the clean training range widened on each side by 12% of its width. The initial bands of R2 for military roles, R3 and R4 (Table C.2 ) were set from the annotations and from knowledge of the aircraft types to contain every clean annotation, those of test and unseen sites included, and the generator oracle of the satellite benchmark was fitted on the clean annotations of every site, so both may carry held-out information; the satellite benchmark was not regenerated, nor the remote-sensing stratum retrained, without them.

blocks.en: Appendix D Data and Benchmark Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 数据和基准细节

blocks.en:
This appendix describes the specification records and the benchmarks built from the records and images of Section : the corruption operators with their realized magnitudes (Table D.1 ), the realized instances per type and split (Appendix D.1 ), the frame of the cross-dataset runs and the rule that chose the examples of Figure . Every generator is deterministic given its seed.
The 107 specification records cover seven classes: wide-body (17 aircraft of 8 families), narrow-body (18 of 6), regional jet (13 of 6), regional turboprop (11 of 8), business jet (19 of 17, the unseen class), general-aviation turboprop (12 of 11) and general-aviation piston (17 of 15). They were compiled from the type-certificate data sheets of the aviation authorities of the United States, the European Union, Canada, the United Kingdom and France and from manufacturer documents (airport-planning manuals, specification sheets and flight-manual excerpts), with other public sources used for cross-checks. The 67 jets declare thrust and the 40 propeller aircraft shaft power, and 18 records, all general-aviation aircraft, declare the stall speed; every record passed a loose screening with the verifier’s physics module, so the clean records were checked against the relations that the verifier evaluates; the intervention labels, set from the edit alone, bypass this dependence. Table D.1 lists the corruption operators. A candidate that the oracle does not flag is generated again with its magnitude doubled, for at most six attempts (Section ), so the realized magnitudes reflect the oracle tolerances and extend beyond the declared grid of 5 and 10%. They extend furthest for performance corruptions, whose Breguet tolerance must absorb the largest residual among the clean records.

blocks.en: D.1 Benchmarks

blocks.en:
Table D.2 gives the realized instances per type and split of four benchmarks: the specification records, the photographic mismatch pairs, the satellite annotations and the satellite multimodal pairs. Of the 100 FGVC-Aircraft variants, 68 are paired with a specification record, 39 with the record of their type and 29 with that of their family; their 6,800 photographs follow the split of the paired family (2,500 training, 1,300 validation, 800 test, 1,500 unseen-family and 700 unseen-class photographs), and the 32 unpaired variants enter no split. The satellite annotations start from 3,000 clean RarePlanes annotations, a sample stratified by role with a floor of 200 annotations per role (all annotations of a rarer role), and each operator draws one candidate from each of them, so the kept and discarded candidates of a type sum to 3,000.
In the cross-dataset runs of Appendix G.5 , a knowledge base fitted on one source scores the other through a 23-field unified frame (Figure (c)) with only the axioms R2 to R4, which both sources can evaluate; a specification record takes its role and design group from its clean wingspan. On the records of each split, the report prints the class of the nearest clean training record (Section ; example in Figure ): this proximity names the class of a record from an unseen family and attributes each business jet, a class absent from training, to its nearest training class.

blocks.en:
This appendix completes the setup of Section : it lists the comparators and the configuration, states how the configuration was selected and which choices used data beyond the training split, and reports how the vision results change when the part detector’s visibility threshold is re-selected on validation data alone.
Table F.1 orders the comparators by the knowledge they receive; each shares the partitions, the labels and the evaluation code of NeSySpec, with settings selected on validation data within a budget fixed before its runs, and one planned arm, the language model in its thinking mode, has no result: in a pilot run too few of its answers could be parsed, below the parse rate fixed before the runs. Table F.2 gives the configuration of every module of NeSySpec, of its optional settings and of the baseline detectors; bands, slopes, latents, visual heads, read-outs, operating thresholds and checkpoints are fitted or selected on data, and every other value was set once. The class bands of the generator oracle are fitted on all 107 aircraft, test and out-of-distribution aircraft included, and reach training through the generator labels and per-constraint targets (Section ); Appendix G.9 refits the oracle without test or out-of-distribution aircraft.

blocks.en: NeSySpec’s configuration was selected on validation data and on held-out training classes; during development, earlier configurations were also evaluated on the test splits. Validation data selected the configuration of both tabular strata, the largest-violation key, the abduction and repair rules and the optional settings, and held-out training classes also selected the key and the critical-field alert (Appendix G.9 ). The rule that reads each constraint as held or violated has no tuned parameter. The part detector’s visibility threshold was moved from 0.25 to 0.20 on a 240-image stratified subset including test and out-of-distribution images, by an informal trade-off, with no numeric criterion and no saved tuning output. The results of this paper use 0.20.
blocks.zh: NeSySpec的配置是在验证数据和被搁置的训练课程中选择的;在开发过程中,早期的配置也被在测试拆分上评价. 验证数据选择了表层的配置,最大违规键,绑架和维修规则以及可选设置,停课的培训班也选择了关键键和临界场警报(附录G.9 ). 将每项约束理解为持有或违反的规则没有调整参数。 部分探测器的能见度阈值由0.25移到0.20,在一个240图像分层的子集上,包括测试和分配外图像,通过非正式的权衡,没有数字标准,也没有节省的调音输出. 本文的结果使用0.20.

blocks.en:
Retrained at 0.25 with the same code, configuration and 8 seeds (even seeds on the RTX 5090, which trained the original module, and odd seeds on the RTX 4090; the even seeds alone give the same accuracy and pointing readings), the photograph module keeps its macro head accuracy (0.916 on test and 0.944 on unseen families, as at 0.20) and at most one collapsed head per seed on test. It also keeps its pointing lead over the network without a localization term ( + 0.671 +0.671 ) and with permuted masks ( + 0.414 +0.414 ), its lead over RRR, GradMask and Pukdee et al. on PASCAL-Part ( + 0.568 +0.568 , + 0.676 +0.676 and + 0.469 +0.469 , every interval above zero) and the nine overall readings of the cross-modal stratum against Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3.5-8B and Qwen3-VL-32B on test, unseen families and the unseen class. Of the 21 readings by pair type, 4 change by one step under each of the two bootstrap streams of that comparison, 3 of them to the disadvantage of the stratum. The networks without a localization term or with permuted masks, RRR, GradMask and Pukdee et al. were trained with the flags at 0.20 and not retrained.
At 0.25 the cross-modal AUROC is 0.693 on test (0.692 at 0.20) and slightly lower on unseen families (0.716 against 0.733) and on the unseen class (0.827 against 0.844); the axiom on engine placement and tail configuration (AX4) is available on 0.784 of the test pairs scored for detection, instead of 0.956. Pointing on pseudo-masks is slightly lower on test (0.774 against 0.780) and on unseen families (0.778 against 0.784): there the seed-bootstrap and the image-and-seed bootstrap intervals include zero, while the intervals over paired seeds, [ − 0.010 , − 0.001 ] [-0.010,\penalty\ -0.001] and [ − 0.010 , − 0.004 ] [-0.010,\penalty\ -0.004] , do not. On PASCAL-Part human masks pointing is slightly lower with 3 runs (0.711 against 0.737, − 0.026 -0.026 [ − 0.051 , − 0.002 ] [-0.051,\penalty\ -0.002] ) and lower over 8 seeds (0.708 against 0.729, − 0.020 -0.020 [ − 0.037 , − 0.005 ] [-0.037,\penalty\ -0.005] ).
The auxiliary loss at weight 0.3, retrained at 0.25 with its 3 seeds, falls on PASCAL-Part as the axiom does (0.708 against 0.739, − 0.031 -0.031 [ − 0.055 , − 0.005 ] [-0.055,\penalty\ -0.005] ). With both at 0.25 the two stay on par in localization on test pseudo-masks ( − 0.009 -0.009 ), out of distribution ( − 0.027 -0.027 ) and on PASCAL-Part ( + 0.003 +0.003 [ − 0.028 , + 0.032 ] [-0.028,\penalty\ +0.032] ), while the axiom keeps its out-of-distribution accuracy lead ( + 0.016 +0.016 [ + 0.010 , + 0.021 ] [+0.010,\penalty\ +0.021] ). With all 8 seeds of the axiom, the axiom’s pointing on test pseudo-masks is slightly lower than that of the auxiliary loss at 0.25 ( − 0.019 -0.019 ) and lower at 0.20 ( − 0.026 -0.026 ). blocks.en: NeSySpec is tested against 14 groups of comparators (Table F.1 ), from knowledge-free detectors, residual learners and tabular foundation models to solvers, constraint losses and prompted language and vision-language models, on six benchmarks, four of them labeled independently of the generator oracle (Table ). Specification records carry two label families, generator and intervention labels, and are evaluated on three splits (test, unseen families and the unseen class), satellite pairs on two (test and unseen sites); each stratum of NeSySpec is trained with eight seeds (seeds 0 to 7, Table F.2 ) and the satellite backbone grid with three seeds per backbone. Unless the text or a table note names another scheme, every interval on specification records rests on 5,000 cluster-bootstrap resamples at each of the two cluster levels (seed 20261002); the removals of Table G.9 use 2,000, and the curve over the number of constraints in Appendix G.8 resamples the subsets of each size and the seeds of each drawn subset (5,000 draws). Tables G.1 to G.4 print 168 contrasts with both intervals, and Table G.8 prints 41, of which 36 are not in Table G.3 . Every primary diagnosis contrast of the largest-violation key keeps its reading in all 20 alternative bootstrap streams, except two on intervention labels, which keep it in 19 and 17 of the 20. So do 11 ablation contrasts, the unseen-class contrasts with half the fields hidden, also under each of 10 further bootstrap seeds of that analysis, and every primary localization and repair contrast except two on the record repair error.

blocks.en: Largest-violation key: the available constraint with the largest violation degree, selected on held-out training classes. Second head: the monotone read-out on the degrees, kept as the secondary key. SHAP: grouped exact Shapley values of the residual model, one group per constraint. Oracle and worst tie-break: ties among the optimal localizations broken toward and away from the altered field. Repair errors, on single-field corruptions: log-space error of the altered field, plus the change of the correct fields for the record; clean records changed: share of the 48 clean and control test records. Class-I PiShield-style ordering: sequential projection onto the crisp constraints, fields in ascending order of their class-I residual. Detection gate: imputation only on the records that the class-I residual flags, a residual outside its 95% prediction interval. Residual-MLP alarm and own alarm: the residual MLP or the verdict at its validation threshold; with the alert, the verdict or NeSySpec’s optional critical-field alert.
blocks.zh: 最大违规键:在被搁置的培训班上选择的、具有最大违规程度的现有制约。 第二头:在学位上读出单调音,作为第二键保存. SHAP:组合了剩余模型的准确的Shapley值,每个约束一组. 甲骨文和最糟糕的解围:与被改变的球场断绝的最佳局部关系。 修补错误,关于单字段腐败:更改字段的日志空格错误,加上为记录而更改的正确字段错误;清洁记录更改:分享48个清洁控制测试记录. I级 PiShield 风格的顺序: 依次投射到粗糙的制约, 字段依其I级残余的递升顺序排列. 检测门:仅在记录上推算为I级残留旗,其95%的预测间隔外的残留. 剩余-MLP警报和自备警报:剩余MLP或在其验证阈值下的判决;带有警报,判决或NeSySpec的可选临界场警报.

blocks.en: From the same degrees, NeSySpec’s largest-violation key names the violated constraint in 0.942 of corrupted test records and in 0.897 ± 0.007 0.897\pm 0.007 on the unseen class, abduction finds the altered field in 0.742 ± 0.011 0.742\pm 0.011 of single-field test corruptions, and the repair proposal lowers the log-space error on the altered field from 0.366 to 0.133 (Table G.6 , the generator-label levels behind Figure b and c; Table G.5 gives the test levels of panel a). On unseen families the key, 0.973 on each seed, is above Fellegi-Holt ( + 0.174 +0.174 [ + 0.051 , + 0.304 ] ⋅ [ + 0.074 , + 0.365 ] [+0.051,\penalty\ +0.304]\cdot\allowbreak[+0.074,\penalty\ +0.365] ), Z3 ( + 0.174 +0.174 [ + 0.047 , + 0.311 ] ⋅ [ + 0.101 , + 0.286 ] [+0.047,\penalty\ +0.311]\cdot\allowbreak[+0.101,\penalty\ +0.286] ), MLP-SHAP ( + 0.077 +0.077 [ + 0.020 , + 0.143 ] ⋅ [ + 0.018 , + 0.189 ] [+0.020,\penalty\ +0.143]\cdot\allowbreak[+0.018,\penalty\ +0.189] ) and LightGBM-SHAP ( + 0.117 +0.117 [ + 0.052 , + 0.184 ] ⋅ [ + 0.055 , + 0.163 ] [+0.052,\penalty\ +0.184]\cdot\allowbreak[+0.055,\penalty\ +0.163] ) and on par with the class-standardized residual ( + 0.018 +0.018 ); these unseen-family contrasts were not checked across the 20 alternative bootstrap streams. Class-I localization names the field of the largest residual of the Class I statistical sizing regressions on maximum take-off mass fitted on the training aircraft (the Class I sizing-regression residual of Section ). MLP-SHAP, the attribution of a second model on the residuals, ranks the violated constraint first more often on the unseen class (0.970), and MICE at the field of the class-I residual is on par with the repair on both errors (0.120 and 0.161); NeSySpec’s key, abduction and repair come with a held or violated verdict per constraint and the report. With 8 seed pairs instead of 5, the optional rank-then-explain setting stays above Fellegi-Holt ( + 0.130 +0.130 ) and Z3 ( + 0.100 +0.100 ) behind the same alarm on test, on par with the class-standardized residual and below NeSySpec’s verdict with its own alarm and the same key ( − 0.028 -0.028 ); strict abstention, which gives no diagnosis when no available degree exceeds ln ⁡ 2 \ln 2 , withdraws the diagnosis of 3 to 5 records per seed, none of them correctly diagnosed.

blocks.en:
Masked quantification makes every verdict of NeSySpec a function of the available evidence alone: Figure in Section shows the exact reduction on specification records and satellite pairs and the unseen class with half the fields hidden, where the masked verdict (0.577) is ahead of the residual MLP and TabPFN v2 with native missing values and on par with LightGBM trained with masks (Table G.2 ). With 10% of the fields hidden in distribution, the MLP trained with masks ranks test records higher ( − 0.0425 -0.0425 ) and the residual MLP unseen-family records ( − 0.0925 -0.0925 ); both read every field, imputed or masked in training, while the masked verdict reads the declared evidence alone and states which constraints remain checkable.
With no field hidden beyond those the records already leave undeclared, the masked verdict is ahead of MICE imputation of every missing field at scoring, by + 0.051 +0.051 [ + 0.031 , + 0.063 ] ⋅ [ + 0.031 , + 0.062 ] [+0.031,\penalty\ +0.063]\cdot\allowbreak[+0.031,\penalty\ +0.062] on test and + 0.035 +0.035 [ + 0.011 , + 0.062 ] ⋅ [ + 0.012 , + 0.064 ] [+0.011,\penalty\ +0.062]\cdot\allowbreak[+0.012,\penalty\ +0.064] on unseen families, and ahead of global means at scoring on every split ( + 0.147 +0.147 , + 0.121 +0.121 and + 0.164 +0.164 ). blocks.en: G.4 Record Coherence
blocks.zh: G.4 记录一致性

blocks.en: NeSySpec’s record verdict reaches a test AUROC of 0.979 ± 0.002 0.979\pm 0.002 on generator labels, from 0.937 on cruise to 1.000 on geometric corruptions by corruption type, each type scored against the 48 clean-labeled test records (16 clean records and their 32 noisy-but-coherent copies; means of 8 seeds), and each of its flags names the violated constraint, the altered field and a repair proposal. Table G.7 groups the detectors of Section by the knowledge they receive, with what each returns. On test the record verdict is on par with TabPFN v2 and close to the residual MLP, LightGBM and the one-class SVM on the residuals and ahead of the learners on the raw fields, the rule checkers, the Mahalanobis distance, the DL2 method and the language model (Table G.3 ). On the unseen class five learners on the residuals rank higher in record-level detection (residual MLP 0.978, TabPFN v2 up to 0.984); there, with NeSySpec’s optional rank-then-explain setting, the residual MLP raises the alarm and NeSySpec explains it with the violated constraint, the altered field and a repair, flagging and correctly diagnosing 0.849 ± 0.043 0.849\pm 0.043 of the corrupted unseen-class records (Table G.6 ).
blocks.zh: NeSySpec的记录判决在发电机标签上得出了0.979±0.002 0.979\pm 0.002的测试,从巡航的0.937到腐败类型的几何腐败的1000,每种类型都与48个有清洁标签的测试记录(16个清洁记录及其32个吵闹但一致的拷贝;8个种子的手段)打分,每个旗帜都标出违反的限制、被改变的球场和修理建议。 表G.7 将科的探测器按它们获得的知识分类,并按每个结果进行分类。 在测试中,记录判决与TabPFN v2相同,并接近残存的MLP、LightGBM和残存的单级SVM,以及生地、规则检查器、Mahalanobis距离、DL2方法和语言模型(表G.3)的学习者。 在未见的五级学习者中,剩余者在记录级检测中排名较高(剩余MLP 0.978,TabPFN v2 至 0.984);在NeSySpec的可选级级表设置下,剩余MLP提高了警示,NeSySpec用违反的制约、改变的球场和修复、标出并正确诊断了腐败的未见级记录中的0.849 ± 0.043 0.849\pm 0.043(表G.6)。

blocks.en: Against intervention labels the record verdict reaches 0.701, 0.750 and 0.719 on test, unseen families and the unseen class, without retraining, while the generator oracle itself, with its bands on all 107 aircraft, reaches 0.676, 0.709 and 0.714 on the same labels. These labels count as incoherent the 613 altered rows that break no constraint under those bands, and as coherent the edits within tolerance, some of which do break one. With only the clean records and their noisy copies as negatives, the verdict reaches 0.840, 0.847 and 0.811. On the altered rows that break no constraint, scored against all clean rows, it stays below chance (0.394, 0.449 and 0.439), as the comparators that use the physics do on the pooled held-out splits.
blocks.zh: 反对干预,记录判决在测试中达到了0.701、0.750和0.719, 看不见的家庭和看不见的阶级,没有再培训,而发电机甲骨文本身及其波段在所有107架飞机上,在同一标签上达到了0.676、0.709和0.714。 这些标签算作613条更改的行的不连贯,这些行在这些带子下没有突破约束,也算作在容忍度范围内的编辑一致,其中一些确实打破了一条. 由于只有干净的记录和它们作为底片的吵闹本,判决达到0.840,0.847和0.811. 在不设限制的改变的排位上,对所有干净排位的得分,它一直低于机会(0.394、0.449和0.439),就像使用物理学的比较者对集合搁置的拆分所做的那样。

blocks.en: G.5 Records with Images
blocks.zh: G.5 带有图像的记录

blocks.en: Without an image, NeSySpec’s fused verdict equals the record verdict bit for bit in 9 of 9 satellite cells, against 0 of 207 learned method and cell rows, and its second head with ConvNeXt-T (8 seeds) reaches 0.998 ± 0.001 0.998\pm 0.001 on test and 0.991 ± 0.003 0.991\pm 0.003 on unseen sites over all pair types. On the satellite pairs of Section , the best learned comparators rank the pairs higher after learning from labeled pairs: CatBoost on knowledge-base truths on test swaps, TabPFN on visual posteriors and image embeddings on unseen-site swaps, and late fusions on knowledge-base truths over all pair types on unseen sites (nine runs of three backbones). Learned heads also rank the pairs higher in the contrasts of Tables G.2 and G.3 , where NeSySpec’s fused verdict differs by − 0.012 -0.012 from the late fusion trained with swaps on test swaps and by − 0.031 -0.031 from CatBoost on knowledge-base truths with 30% of the images hidden. The fused verdict, instead, aggregates NeSySpec’s strata without labels and names the contradicted axiom; on photographs, Qwen3-VL-32B ranks unseen-family pairs higher than the cross-modal stratum ( − 0.094 -0.094 ). With 30% of satellite images hidden, the fused verdict (0.947) keeps the exact reduction; the read-out trained with modality dropout ranks the pairs at 0.973 without keeping it. When a visual stratum trained on ground photographs scores satellite crops, the record verdict alone (0.796) is the fallback across sensors without labels: the fused verdict reaches 0.724 and an out-of-domain abstention restores the record level, while the fusion selected with satellite labels reaches 0.786 and a refit trained on satellite labels, a reference with privileged access to them, reaches 0.979. Fitted on specification records and applied without satellite training through the shared axioms R2 to R4 (Appendix D.1 ), the knowledge base reaches 0.767 ± 0.007 0.767\pm 0.007 on satellite test annotations and 0.764 ± 0.008 0.764\pm 0.008 on unseen sites, against 0.796 and 0.812 for the remote-sensing record verdict trained on these annotations; fitted on satellite annotations and applied to specification records, it reaches 0.541 ± 0.003 0.541\pm 0.003 (8 seeds, no interval); the military roles, absent from the records, keep their prior bands. Comparators on satellite pairs were not retrained or retuned, and those that read knowledge-base truths (CatBoost and TabPFN on knowledge-base truths, the best fusion and the fusion selected without satellite labels) keep the truths of the saturating-envelope variant of the remote-sensing stratum they were fitted on (the specification-record row of this ablation is in Table G.8 ). NeSySpec’s graded remote-sensing stratum was selected on validation among eight candidate configurations; it trains with per-constraint targets that the end-to-end, fusion and vision-language comparators do not receive, and its validation split serves both early stopping and the choice of configuration.
blocks.zh: NeSySpec在没有图像的情况下,在9个卫星细胞的9个细胞中,与207个学过的方法和细胞排中的0个相比,其第二头与ConvNEXt-T(8个种子)的比分等于记录的比分,在测试中,NeSySpec的比分为0.998±0.098/pm0.001,在不见地点的0.091±0.0030.991/pm0.003,在所有对类型上。 在科的卫星对子上,最有学识的比较者在从标注的对子中学习后排名更高:CatBoost在测试互换上对知识基础的真理,TabPFN在视觉后方和图像嵌入在隐形的互换上,在知识基础的真理上晚聚在隐形的站点上对所有的对子类型(9个运行3个骨干). 在G.2表和G.3表的对比中, 学习头也把对子排列得更高, NeSySpec的结合判断与接受测试交换交换训练的晚期聚变相比, 相反,保险定案将NeSySpec的层层叠加起来,没有标签,也没有名称。 在照片上,Qune3-VL-32B将隐形家庭对排在跨模式层(−0.094-0.94)之上。 随着30%的卫星图象被隐藏,保险判决(0.947)保持了准确的减少;通过模式退出培训的读出数在不保留的情况下将对数排在0.973。 当接受地面照片训练的视觉层对卫星作物进行评分时,仅记录裁定(0.796)就是没有标签的传感器的倒置:引信判定达到0.724,域外弃权者恢复记录水平,而使用卫星标签选择的聚变则达到0.786,卫星标签培训的重置则达到0.979。 知识库以规格记录为基础,未经卫星训练即通过共用轴线R2至R4(附录D.1)加以应用,卫星试验说明达到0.767±0.007 0.767\pm 0.007,在秘密地点达到0.764±0.008 0.764\pm 0.008,而根据这些说明训练的遥感记录裁定则达到0.796和0.812;在卫星说明上安装并适用于规格记录,达到0.541±0.003 0.541\pm 0.003(8个种子,无间隔);没有记录的军事作用保持其先前的频带。 卫星对子上的比较器没有重新训练或重新调整,那些读取知识基础真理(CatBoost和TabPFN关于知识基础真理、最佳聚变和无卫星标签选择的聚变)的比较器保留了它们所搭配的遥感层饱和-信封变体的真理(这种衰减的规格记录行载于表G.8)。 NeSySpec的分级遥感层是在8个候选配置中进行验证时选定的;它以终端到终端、聚变和视线语言的参照方不接收的每个约束目标进行训练,它的验证分裂既服务于早期停止,也服务于配置的选择。

blocks.en: G.6 Grounding
blocks.zh: G.6 设地

blocks.en: On the FGVC pseudo-masks the grounding axiom raises test pointing over the network without a localization term on every backbone, by + 0.664 +0.664 with ConvNeXt-T, + 0.699 +0.699 with ResNet-50 at 512 pixels, + 0.615 +0.615 with ViT token-CAM and + 0.677 +0.677 with ResNet-50 at 448 pixels (8 against 3 seeds), each with an exact seed-bootstrap interval above zero. Figure G.1 gives its pointing levels against the controls (panel a, over its 8 seeds on FGVC-Aircraft and its 3 runs at weight 1 on PASCAL-Part; the location prior, a reference without learning, always points to the grid cell that the part covers most often in other images: the training images for FGVC-Aircraft and the other half of the images for PASCAL-Part) and its comparison with the localization and explanation-supervision methods (panel b, 3 runs per method at the weights selected on validation, where the axiom points to the part in 0.790 of test pseudo-masks). At the same loss weight the auxiliary loss puts about 4.3 times the axiom’s localization weight on each conjunct (Section ), so the two are compared at their weights selected on validation (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 在FGVC伪面板上,地面轴提高测试在网络上标注每个主干线上没有本地化术语,使用ConvNEXt-T的+0.664+0.664,使用ResNet-50的+0.699+0.699,使用512像素的+0.615+0.615,使用VIT标志-CAM的+0.677+0.677,使用ResNet-50的+0.677,使用448像素的+0.664,使用(8对3个种子),每个种子的精确种子-短距高于零。 图G.1显示其对照控件的点数(FGVC-Aircraft上的8个种子的A组和PASCAL-Part上的3个种子的重量1;前一个位置,一个不学习的参考点,总是指向该部分在其他图像中最常覆盖的网格单元格:FGVC-Aircraft的培训图像和PASCAL-Part的另外一半图像),以及它与定位和解释-监督方法的比较(B组,每个方法在验证时选择的重量时运行3个,其中轴指向试验伪质量的0.790部分)。 在同一损失重量中,辅助损失将轴重的大约4.3倍于每个连接体(第2节)的本地化重量,因此在审定时选定的重量上比较了两者(附录H)。

blocks.en: G.7 Deliberate Falsification
blocks.zh: G.7 蓄意伪造

blocks.en: Each of the 736 falsification problems inflates one capacity of a genuine held-out record, the range, the cruise speed, the maximum take-off mass or the ceiling, by 5, 10, 20 or 40% (46 records: the 16 clean test records, 11 of unseen families and 19 of the unseen class). A bare lie submits the inflated record; a cover-up also edits up to five further declared fields within the ranges of the fleet, found by a black-box search that reads only the detector’s score; an omission withholds up to two declared fields other than the inflated one. A lie evades a detector when the submitted record scores below the detector’s validation threshold, and evasion is the share of evading lies among the problems whose genuine record the detector accepts; the smallest number of further edits that covers a flagged lie is censored at six.
blocks.zh: 736个伪造问题中,每个问题都夸大了真正的搁置记录、射程、巡航速度、最大起飞质量或上限的1个容量,增加5、10、20或40%(46个记录:16个清洁测试记录、11个未见家庭记录和19个未见阶层记录)。 一个赤裸裸的谎言会提交夸大的记录;一个遮盖也会编辑在舰队范围内另外多达5个被宣布的字段,这些字段是由只读出探测器分数的黑箱搜索发现的;一个遗漏会保留最多两个被夸大字段以外的被宣布的字段. 当提交记录的分数低于探测器的验证阈值时,谎言会躲避探测器,而逃避是探测器接受的真实记录的问题中隐藏的部分;覆盖标记的谎言的编辑次数最少,则在六点时审查。

blocks.en: NeSySpec with the critical-field alert, an optional setting, flags a record when the verdict or the alert fires. Under black-box falsification, a lie flagged by NeSySpec’s record verdict is covered less often than one flagged by the residual MLP: with up to five further edits 0.936 of cover-ups pass against 1.000 (Table G.4 ), and 0.247 of its flagged bare lies cannot be covered, against 0.000. The smallest cover of one of its flagged lies has 2.69 further edited fields on average (2.68 with the critical-field alert), against 1.01 to 1.63 for the learned detectors (on the residuals, MLP 1.38, LightGBM 1.37 and TabPFN v2 1.63) and more for the Mahalanobis distance and the pooled rules (3.45 and 3.62; point estimates, censored at six). On the 72 problems that the verdict and the residual MLP flag on every seed, 0.413 of the verdict’s flagged lies cannot be covered, against 0.000, with 3.76 edits per cover against 1.58. On omissions of up to two fields and on bare lies some comparators are evaded less often (Table G.4 : on omissions the residual MLP + 0.026 +0.026 , the residual one-class SVM + 0.143 +0.143 and the Mahalanobis distance + 0.119 +0.119 ; on bare lies residual LightGBM + 0.052 +0.052 and residual TabPFN v2 + 0.105 +0.105 ). A withheld field masks the axioms that read it (Proposition ); with the optional critical-field alert, which names the undeclared field and the constraints it leaves unchecked, NeSySpec is evaded less than the residual MLP with the same alert on unseen families ( − 0.074 -0.074 ) and more on the unseen class ( + 0.125 +0.125 ). On this fleet a rule without the knowledge base (an alert on any undeclared field that the record’s class, or its engine type for classes with fewer than five training records, declares in at least 95% of the training records, whether or not an applicable axiom reads it) gives the alert’s protection with the same false alerts on the genuine records; NeSySpec’s report also names the constraints that each withheld field leaves unchecked.
blocks.zh: NeSySpec带有临界场警报,可选设置,标出判决或警报火灾时的记录. 在黑盒伪造的情况下,NeSySpec的记录判决所标注的谎言被覆盖的频率低于剩余MLP所标注的谎言:最多再编辑5个封面的0.936次,超过1 000次(表G.4),超过0.247次其标注的赤裸的谎言则无法覆盖。 其标有标记的谎言中最小的封面平均有2.69个字段(2.68个带有临界场警报)经过进一步编辑,而所学探测器的封面平均为1.01至1.63个(余下部分为MLP 1.38、LightGBM 1.37和TabPFN v2 1.63),更多的是马哈拉诺比斯距离和集合规则(3.45和3.62;点估计值为6,审查)。 关于判决和每个种子上残留的MLP旗的72个问题,判决标注的谎言中,有0.413个无法覆盖,每封面有3.76个编辑,1.58个。 关于最多两个字段的遗漏和赤裸裸的谎言,有些参照国被回避的次数较少(表G.4:关于遗漏的剩余MLP + 0.026 + 0.026, 剩余单级SVM + 0143 + 0.143 和 Mahalanobis 距离 + 0.119 + 0.119;关于裸露的剩余LightGBM + 0.052 和剩余 TabPFN v2 + 0.105 + 0.105 ) ,一个被扣的字段遮掩读出的轴线(提案);带有可选的关键字段警示,命名未申报的字段及其留下的制约,NeSySpec比余的MLP 少,对看不见的家庭有同样的警示(0.074 - 0.074),对看不见的类别有更多的警示(+0.125)。 在这个舰队中,一个没有知识库的规则(即对于记录的班级或其发动机类型对不到5个训练记录的班级的任何未申报的场次的警示,在至少95%的训练记录中宣布,是否有适用的轴线读取它)提供了警示保护,并在真实记录中发出同样的虚假警示;NeSySpec的报告还列举了每个被扣的场所留下的限制。

blocks.en: G.8 Ablation and Other Forms of the Same Knowledge
blocks.zh: G.8 同一知识的承认和其他形式的承认

blocks.en: Training the knowledge base through Real Logic is ahead of the same knowledge base at its initial values on every split ( + 0.073 +0.073 , + 0.061 +0.061 and + 0.088 +0.088 ), and the full model is ahead of the saturating-envelope ablation and of the ablation with flat banks on every split; Table G.8 gives each ablation with its difference and both intervals, Section states the reading, and the textbook prior, a sensitivity, is on par with the full model on test and the unseen class and close to it on unseen families. On satellite pairs, a single masked quantifier in place of the strata ranks unseen-site pairs higher (differences − 0.008 -0.008 with 30% of the images withheld and − 0.013 -0.013 with all images) and is close to the fused verdict on test, while NeSySpec’s strata keep one verdict per evidence source, so the report says whether the record or the image raised the flag.
blocks.zh: 通过Real Logic对知识基础进行的培训,在每次拆分(+0.073+0.073,+0.061和+0.088+0.088)的初始值上都领先于相同的知识基础,整个模型在每一次拆分上都领先于饱和信封膨胀和扁平银行的膨胀;表G.8给出了每一次拆分的差别和间隔,节说明阅读和教科书之前的敏感性,在测试和看不见的班级上与完全模型相同,在看不见的家庭上接近。 在卫星对子上,一个代替层层的单面遮盖的修饰词排高一些(差幅-0.008 - 0.008,30%的图像被扣,0.013 - 0.013,所有图像被扣),并且接近测试时的引信判断,而NeSySpec的层层每个证据源都保留一个判断,因此报告说记录或图像是升旗。

blocks.en: To measure what each constraint contributes, NeSySpec was retrained with subsets of its 12 specification constraints. A removed constraint is unavailable for every record in training and scoring, while the record labels of training stay unchanged. The record verdict was then scored on intervention labels, which no constraint defines, and on generator labels, which the same constraints define, so that a removal hides the corruptions of its constraint by construction (Figure in Section , all panels on intervention labels; Table G.9 ). Over 96 subsets of 1 to 11 constraints, all 12 of sizes 1 and 11 and 8 random ones of each size from 2 to 10, with 3 seeds each, and the full knowledge base, the intervention-label AUROC averaged over test, unseen families and the unseen class has a mean per size that rises from one size to the next, from 0.535 with one constraint to 0.723 with all twelve (Spearman 0.93 [ 0.90 , 0.95 ] [0.90,\penalty\ 0.95] ), by steps whose intervals include zero at 5 of the 11 steps. The returns diminish: a logarithmic trend fits better than a linear one ( R 2 R^{2} 0.87 against 0.84; on the unseen class alone the two fit equally), the gain is about 0.028 per constraint up to six and 0.008 beyond, and the twelfth still adds a small gain (0.009 [ 0.003 , 0.015 ] [0.003,\penalty\ 0.015] ). The AUROC grows linearly with the share of edits that alter a field read by some active constraint ( R 2 R^{2} 0.88, against 0.74 for a logarithmic trend), a share that goes from 0.22 with one constraint to all edits with twelve, while on the edits of fields the constraints read it stays between 0.70 and 0.75 at every size: the gain follows the coverage of the edits. The residual MLP on the same subsets gains from the same knowledge (0.540 to 0.706), with no trend in its gap to NeSySpec. Removing one constraint from the full knowledge base lowers the intervention-label AUROC for A5 and A2, slightly for A4, A7 and A8 and for A4 with A4P together, and leaves it on par for A1, A4P, A9 and A10 and close for A3, A6 and A11; removing A1 lowers it on the unseen class and raises it slightly on test, and no removal raises it averaged over the three splits. Stall speed, engine count and fuselage length, the fields that only A6, A9 and A11 read, are never edited alone in the intervention records, and stall speed is never edited at all; A3, A4P and A10 read only fields that other constraints also read, as do A2, A4, A7 and A8, whose removal still lowers the AUROC, slightly for A4, A7 and A8. On generator labels the removal of A1, A2, A4, A4P, A5 or A8 lowers the AUROC, that of A7 or A10 slightly, and that of A3 raises it slightly (0.001); abduction is lower without A1 (0.187), A5 (0.077), A3, A4, A4P, A8 and A11, slightly lower without A2, A7 and A10, and on par without A6 and A9. In Figure c the darker line gives the aircraft interval and the lighter the family interval, with filled points where both exclude zero.
blocks.zh: 为了衡量每一种制约因素的贡献,NeSySpec被重新培训了12个规格限制的子集。 培训和评分的每一记录都没有取消的限制,而培训的记录标签保持不变。 记录判决随后在干预标签(没有约束定义)和生成者标签(有相同的约束定义)上得分,这样,删除会掩盖建筑限制的腐败(第......节中的图,干预标签上的所有面板;表G.9)。 96个子集1至11个约束,所有12个大小1和11以及8个随机1个大小从2个到10个,每个大小有3个种子,而完整的知识基础,干预标签AUROC在测试时平均值,隐形家庭和隐形阶层的每个大小均值从0.535个,一个限制增加到0.723个,所有12个(Spearman 0.93 [0.90, 0.95] [0.90,\penalty\ 0.95]),其间隔包括11个步骤中的5个。 回报率下降:对数趋势比线性趋势(R 2 R^{2} 0.87对 0.84;仅在看不见的类别中,两者同样合适),增益约为0.028每次约束,超过6次和0.08次,第12次仍增加小收益(0.009 [0.003, 0.015] [0.003,\penalty\ 0.015] ) 。 AUROC的线性增长,因为编辑部分修改了一个字段(R 2 R^{2} 0.88,对正数趋势为0.74),这一份额从0.22次限制到所有编辑12次不等,而在编辑部分中,它只读到0.70至0.75次。 同一子集上的剩余MLP从同一知识(0.540至0.706)中得益,与NeSySpec没有差距的趋势. 消除了全部知识库中的一项限制,降低了A5和A2、A4、A7和A8以及A4的干预标签AUROC,A1、A4P、A9和A10加在一起,A3、A6和A11的干预标签AUROC;删除A1的干预标签在看不见的类别中降低,并在测试中略微提高,任何清除都会提高三次分裂的平均值。 A3、A4P和A10只读过其他限制的字段,如A2、A4、A7和A8,其去除仍然降低AUROC,对A4、A7和A8来说略低。 在发电机的标签上,A1、A2、A4、A4P、A5或A8的去除比AUROC低,A7或A10略低,A3稍高(0.001);没有A1(0.187)、A5(0.077)、A3、A4、A4P、A8和A11的绑架率较低,没有A2、A7和A10的去除率略低,没有A6和A9的去除率较低。 在图c中,较暗的线给出飞机间隔和较轻的家族间隔,其中填充点均排除0.

blocks.zh: 表G.9: 消除了知识库中的规格限制。

blocks.en: Drop: the full knowledge base minus the knowledge base without the constraint, 8 seeds each, paired on the same records; detection averaged over test, unseen families and the unseen class, abduction over the 695 single-field intervention records of the three splits. Intervals: [aircraft] above [family], 95% cluster-bootstrap percentiles, 2,000 draws. Generator labels are defined by the same constraints, so a removal hides the corruptions of its constraint by construction.

blocks.en: G.9 Selected Components and Sensitivity Analyses
blocks.zh: G.9 选定组成部分和敏感性分析

blocks.en: The diagnosis key was selected on held-out training classes: with each of the six training classes left out in turn, the verifier retrained and every statistic, prior and head recomputed without it, the largest-violation key ranked a violated constraint first in 0.802 of the held-out corrupted records (mean over the six classes), against 0.630 for the second head, with a higher mean on each held-out class (differences from 0.006 to 0.432); on validation records of the seen classes the two keys differ by 0.0008, and the second head is kept as the secondary key. NeSySpec’s optional critical-field alert was selected because, on validation, it lowered evasion by an attacker who knows the alert from 0.949 to 0.739 and fired on 2 of the 17 genuine validation records, and because, with each training class held out in turn, it fired on 0.028 of that class’s genuine records (mean over six classes; limit 0.25; largest rate 0.091, against 0.263 on the unseen class). Validation selected the abduction rule, the smallest-change rule of Table F.2 , and its feasibility threshold 0.9, also chosen in 7 of 8 leave-one-seed-out selections. With threshold 0.8, abduction reaches 0.750 on single-field test corruptions, its readings against minimum-cardinality localization unchanged and still ahead of the Class I residual on test. The largest-feasibility rule of Table G.2 , which ranks every field by the lowest verdict it reaches, gives 0.692 on test, 0.747 on unseen families and 0.660 on the unseen class, on par with the Class I residual on test. On intervention labels every reading holds under both alternatives except the margin over the oracle tie-break ( + 0.112 +0.112 and + 0.095 +0.095 ). For a class without training aircraft NeSySpec reads fleet statistics; five alternative reference statistics (engine-type or declared-mass pools with the union or weighted mean of class bands, and the nearest training class), compared on held-out training classes, met no adoption rule, and on the business jets each flags every clean record (1.000 against 0.322 with fleet statistics) with a detection AUROC of 0.836 to 0.906 against 0.934; under the mass pools and the nearest class a withheld field changes the reference class of 16.0, 21.7 and 1.8% of masked held-out records.
blocks.zh: 在停课的培训班上选择了诊断钥匙:由于六个培训班中的每一门都留了出来,核查员又重新训练,每门统计、前科和头部重新计算,最大的违规钥匙在停课的腐败记录中(平均在六门以上)在0.802中排第一,而第二门则排在0.630,每门停课的平均值较高(差幅从0.006到0.432);在被见课的审定记录中,两门钥匙相差0.08,第二门钥匙作为第二门钥匙。 NeSySpec的可选关键场警报被选中,因为在验证时,它将一名知道警报的进攻者逃逸率从0.949降至0.739,并向17个真正验证记录中的2个开火,而且,由于每个训练班轮流举行,它向该班的0.028个真实记录开火(平均超过6个班;限制0.25;最大率0.091,而看不见的班次为0.263)。 鉴定选择了绑架规则,表F.2中最小的修改规则,及其可行性阈值0.9, 也是在8个一种子选择中的7个选择. 以0.8的门槛值计算,单场测试腐败时绑架达到0.750,其最低心率局部化的读数保持不变,在测试时仍然领先于I级残留. 表G.2中最大的可行性规则,按照它所达到的最低判断,每个领域都得到0.692的测试,在看不见的家庭得到0.747的测试,在看不见的阶层得到0.660的测试,与I级的剩余测试相同。 除了甲骨文结节的比值(+ 0.112+0.112和+ 0.095+0.095 ) 外,在两种选择下,每个读数都标注在两种选择下(NeSySpec号没有训练飞机的班级读数统计;5种替代参考统计(与联盟或班段加权平均值的发动机型或申报质量池,以及最近的培训班级)),在被停课的班级上,没有遵守收养规则;在商务喷气机上,每张旗帜的清晰记录(1.000比0.322比0.322比0.934),检测到AUROC为0.836比0.906;在质量库和最近的班级下,一个被扣留的场改变了16.0、21.7和1.8 % 的遮掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩掩

blocks.en: On generator labels, every band alternative that places more of NeSySpec’s learned bands inside the training fleet range widened by 12%, [ 0.88 ​ min , 1.12 ​ max ] [0.88\min,\,1.12\max] , lowers validation detection by more than 0.005: the learned bands act as tolerances learned from the fleet, 45.7% of them with both edges inside that range. The alternatives project the band edges onto that range after every step, or pull them toward it with a penalty of weight 0.01, 0.1 or 1.0 (eight seeds each). Retrained on intervention labels, the four alternatives hold 68.5, 86.7, 96.5 and 100% of the 46 counted bands per seed (those with a training fleet range) inside the range and stay within the validation margin; the projection reaches 0.804 on test, against 0.807 for NeSySpec retrained on the same labels. The penalty of weight 0.01, the alternative selected on validation, keeps its share at 45.7% and was not adopted; it reaches on generator-label test a detection AUROC of 0.977, on par with 0.979, the same diagnosis top-1 (0.942), a localization top-1 of 0.728 against 0.742 and a false-positive rate on the controls of 0.082 against 0.086, and on the unseen class a detection AUROC slightly lower, 0.932 against 0.934; with weight 1.0 (53.8% inside) unseen-class detection is lower, 0.924 against 0.934. These alternatives are sensitivity analyses of NeSySpec.
blocks.zh: 在生成器标签上,将更多NeSySpec学习的乐队放入训练舰队范围的每一个带的替代品都拓宽了12%,[0.88 min,1.12 max] [0.88\min,\,1.12\max],将验证检测比0.005以上:学习的乐队起到从舰队中学习到的耐受性作用,45.7%的乐队在训练舰队范围内有两种边缘。 替代品在每一步后将波段边缘投射到这个范围上,或者用0.01、0.1或1.0(每个8个种子)的分量将其拉向这个范围。 在干预标签上进行再培训,四个替代品的每个种子(具有训练车队范围的种子)的46个计数波段有68.5、86.7、96.5和100%在射程内保留在验证范围内;在测试时,预测值达到0.804,而NeSySpec的预测值为0.807。 0.01重量的处罚是审定时选择的替代办法,其份额保持在45.7%,没有被采用;在发电机标签试验时,检测到0.977的AUROC,与0.979相同,诊断最高值为0.942,本地化最高值为0.728对0.742,控制值为0.082对0.086的假阳性率,而在看不见的类别中,检测到的AUROC略低,为0.932对0.934;在1.0重量(53.8%)的隐性级检测较低,为0.924对0.934. 这些替代品是对NeSySpec的敏感性分析.

blocks.en: With the class bands of the generator oracle fitted on the 44 clean training aircraft alone (business jets, which have no training aircraft, on the band of all training aircraft), and the generator, its seed and the family splits unchanged, the benchmark holds 1,239 instances instead of 1,312. These bands flag 38 of the 63 clean held-out aircraft, 15 of the 16 in test, mostly on A1, A9 and A11; controls must stay clean under the oracle, so the test controls fall from 32 to 4. NeSySpec was retrained with its selected configuration on 8 seeds, as were the residual MLP and TabPFN v2 with their full selection protocol and the DL2-loss network with its selected hyperparameters, whose search was not repeated; the crisp edits and minimum-cardinality localization were recomputed, and the rule diagnosis, TabPFN v2 on intervention labels and the alternative bootstrap streams were not rerun (Tables G.10 and G.11 ). The validation rule of the crisp edits now selects per-class bands without pooling (validation AUROC 0.919 against 0.915), the bands of the new label oracle itself, with which the crisp edits lead NeSySpec on generator labels in key and macro-F1 on every split; the tables keep the pooled bands of the paper, and on intervention labels NeSySpec is on par with the unpooled crisp edits in macro-F1 on test ( − 0.006 -0.006 ) and ahead on the other two splits. On intervention labels, whose records are the same under both oracles, NeSySpec stays ahead on every split of the DL2-loss network in macro-F1 ( + 0.045 +0.045 [ + 0.012 , + 0.142 ] ⋅ [ + 0.012 , + 0.163 ] [+0.012,\penalty\ +0.142]\cdot\allowbreak[+0.012,\penalty\ +0.163] on test), of Fellegi-Holt and Z3 in diagnosis ( + 0.126 +0.126 and + 0.092 +0.092 on test) and of minimum-cardinality localization with random tie-break ( + 0.226 +0.226 on test); on test it is on par with the oracle tie-break ( + 0.079 +0.079 ) and with the crisp edits in macro-F1 ( − 0.016 -0.016 ), and the DL2-loss network has the higher exact-set agreement ( − 0.149 -0.149 ) and fewer false violations. NeSySpec’s own test levels there are lower, with more false violations, every paired interval excluding zero: macro-F1 0.488 against 0.575, exact-set agreement 0.070 against 0.283, false-violation rate 0.219 against 0.084, key 0.732 against 0.786 and abduction 0.532 against 0.593, while detection is on par (0.695 against 0.701). On unseen families key, abduction and detection are on par and macro-F1 comparable (0.666 against 0.694), exact-set agreement is lower (0.255 against 0.373) and the false-violation rate slightly higher (0.088 against 0.028); on the unseen class the verdicts, abduction and detection are on par and the key is lower (0.743 against 0.778). Trained on the flags of these bands through its per-constraint targets, NeSySpec learns narrower bands where the oracle’s bands narrow. Over the 46 counted bands, the median ratio of its learned widths to those learned under the paper’s oracle is 0.903 (seed-bootstrap interval [ 0.897 , 0.911 ] [0.897,\penalty\ 0.911] ), and 64% of the bands narrow, with a moderate rank correlation with the oracle’s width ratios over 45 class bands (Spearman 0.43). The narrowing is largest for the thrust bands of A9 and the passenger-density bands of A11 (median 0.71), which carry the largest rises in false violations on the 16 clean test aircraft ( + 0.35 +0.35 and + 0.33 +0.33 ; 0.061 to 0.208 over all constraints), followed by A2 ( + 0.26 +0.26 ), whose learned bands shift. Seven of its eight seeds reached their best epoch by epoch 22, against 80 to 100 for the paper’s seeds; the seed whose best epoch is 93 shows a similar narrowing on the bands of A3 and the thrust bands of A9 (0.78 and 0.74) and a smaller one on the passenger-density bands of A11 (0.78). On generator labels the records differ between the two benchmarks: the held-out corrupted records keep the violations their clean origin already has under the narrower bands, and the clean record itself stays labeled clean. There the residual MLP is slightly higher in detection on test (0.950 against 0.910, − 0.040 -0.040 [ − 0.075 , − 0.010 ] ⋅ [ − 0.071 , + 0.001 ] [-0.075,\penalty\ -0.010]\cdot\allowbreak[-0.071,\penalty\ +0.001] ) and on unseen families ( − 0.013 -0.013 ), as is TabPFN v2 on unseen families ( − 0.020 -0.020 ), and stays slightly ahead on the unseen class (0.986 against 0.959), where TabPFN v2 is now on par ( − 0.008 -0.008 ). The key reaches 0.944 on test and 0.931 on unseen families (0.973 before), slightly ahead of Fellegi-Holt and Z3 on test ( + 0.102 +0.102 ) and on par with them on unseen families ( + 0.094 +0.094 ); on the unseen class, where the pooled crisp bands equal those of the label oracle, Fellegi-Holt and Z3 lead ( − 0.094 -0.094 ). The verdicts stay ahead of the DL2-loss network in macro-F1 on every split ( + 0.288 +0.288 on test), are on par with the crisp edits on test and unseen families and below them on the unseen class ( − 0.125 -0.125 ), with more false violations than the crisp edits on every split. Abduction is now ahead of the oracle tie-break on test ( + 0.199 +0.199 [ + 0.042 , + 0.370 ] ⋅ [ + 0.052 , + 0.528 ] [+0.042,\penalty\ +0.370]\cdot\allowbreak[+0.052,\penalty\ +0.528] ) and stays ahead of random tie-breaking on every split. The repair still lowers the error on the altered field on every split (0.126 against 0.236 without repair on test); as the verifier now rates almost every clean and control test record as violating, its target is reached on 0.036 of single-field test records (0.555 before) and it proposes a change for 0.988 of the clean and control test records (0.588 on unseen families and 0.707 on the unseen class); the repair rule re-selected on the new validation split (feasibility threshold 0.8 instead of 0.9) reaches the target on 0.190 and changes 0.894 of them. Bands fitted on all 107 aircraft cover the range of the fleet the records describe, which bands fitted on 44 aircraft do not.
blocks.zh: 由于发电机甲骨文的班段仅安装在44架清洁训练飞机上(所有训练飞机的班段上没有训练飞机的商务喷气机),而且发电机、其种子和家属的班段没有变化,基准为1 239例,而不是1 312例。 这些波段旗舰63架清洁被扣留的飞机中的38架,16架中的15架在试飞中,大多在A1,A9和A11上;控制必须在甲骨文下保持清洁,因此测试控制从32架降至4架. NeSySpec在8个种子上重新进行了其选定配置的训练,其余的MLP和TabPFN v2及其全部选择协议和DL2-损失网络及其选定的超参数没有重复搜索;对简洁的编辑和最小心率本地化进行了重新计算,规则诊断、关于干预标签的TabPFN v2和替代靴子流没有重新运行(表G.10和G.11)。 简洁编辑的验证规则现在在不集合的情况下选择每类频段(验证AUROC 0.919对0.915),新标签甲骨文本身的频段,简洁编辑将NeSySpec引导到每分键和宏F1的生成器标签上;表格保留论文的集合频段,干预标签NeSySpec与在测试(−0.06-0.06)的宏F1中未集合的简洁编辑和在其他两分键上领先。 在两个甲骨文下记录相同的干预标签上,NeSySpec在大型F1(+0.045+0.045[+0.012],+0.142])的DL2-损耗网络每分一次前行,在诊断中Fellegi-Holt和Z3(+0.126+0.126和+0.092+0.092),在随机断带的最小心力局部化(+0.226+0.226)[+0.012,\cpenalty\+0.142]\cdot=allowbreak[+0.012,+penalty\+0.163],在测试中F1(+0.016-0.016),DL2-损耗网络有较高的精确定值协议(0.149.1-0)和较少的虚假协议。 NeSySpec本身的测试水平较低,有较多的不实违规行为,每对间隔排除0:宏-F1 0.488对0.575,精确设定的协议0.070对0.283,假违约率为0.219对0.084,键0.732对0.786,绑架0.532对0.593,而探测值相同(0.695对0.701)。 在隐形家庭钥匙上,绑架和侦测处于等值和宏观F1可比(0.666对0.694),确切设定的协议较低(0.255对0.373),虚假侵权率略高(0.088对0.028);在隐形类上,判决、绑架和侦测处于等值,钥匙较低(0.743对0.778)。 NeSySpec通过每个约束对象在这些乐队的旗帜上训练, 在46个计数的波段上,其学习到的宽度与论文甲骨文下学习到的波段的中位比为0.903(种子-波茨夹间隔[0.897,0.911][0.897,\penalty\ 0.911]),64%的波段缩小,与甲骨文的宽度比在45个等级波段(Spearman 0.43)之间有中位关系. 收缩幅度最大的是A9的推力波段和A11的客密度波段(中间值0.71),这些波段在16架清洁试验飞机(+0.35+0.35和+0.33+0.33; 0.061–0.208凌驾于所有限制)上的虚假侵犯事件最多,其次是A2(+0.26+0.26),其学习的波段转移. 它的8个种子中有7个在22世纪达到最佳的时代,而纸质种子则有80到100个;其93个最佳时代的种子显示,A3的波段和A9的推力波段(0.78和0.74)也有类似的缩小,A11的客密度波段(0.78)有较小的缩小. 在生成器标签上,记录在两个基准上有所不同:被搁置的腐烂记录保持其清洁来源已经在较窄的带下,而清洁记录本身则保持标签干净。 在试验中(0.950对0.910、0.040-0.40[0.075、0.010]][0.071、+0.001][0.075、\惩罚\ -0.010]\cdot\ allowbreak[0.071、\惩罚\ +0.001])和在隐形家庭(0.013-0.013)的检测中,残留的MLP略高,在隐形家庭(0.020-0.020)的TabPFN v2(0.986-0.0020)上,在隐形阶层(0.986-0099)上,TabPFN v2现在处于平面(0.008-0.008),保持略高。 钥匙在试验时达到0.944,在未见家属(前0.973)上达到0.931,在试验时略高于Fellegi-Holt和Z3(+0.102+0.102),在未见家属(+0.094+0.094);在未见阶层上,集合脆带与标签甲骨文、Fellegi-Holt和Z3铅(−0.094-0.94)相同。 判决以宏F1(测试时为+0.288+0.288)的DL2损失网络为首,与测试时的简洁编辑和未见家属的简洁编辑相同,低于未见阶层的简洁编辑(−0.125-0.125),与每次简洁编辑相比,虚假的违规行为更多。 绑架案现在领先于甲骨文系断试验(+0.199+0.199 [+0.042,+0.370]) ⋅ [+0.052,+0.528] [+0.042,\penalty\+0.370]\cdot\allowbreak [+0.052,\penalty\+0.528]),并保持领先于任意系断每分. 修复工作仍然降低了每个拆分(0.126比0.236没有在测试中修复)上被改变的球场的误差;由于核查者现在将几乎所有的清洁和控制测试记录评为违规,因此它的目标在单场测试记录的0.036上达到(前0.555),它建议修改0.988的清洁和控制测试记录(在看不见的家庭为0.588,在看不见的类别为0.707);在新的验证拆分(可行性阈值0.8而不是0.9)上重新选择的修复规则在0.190上达到目标,其中0.894的修改. 所有107架飞机上安装的波段覆盖记录所述的机队范围,44架飞机上安装的波段没有。

blocks.en: Fitted on the 61 clean training and validation aircraft, the oracle had each of its three tolerances set, by a rule declared before any result, to the smallest value of a grid that flags at most 5% of the clean aircraft when their family is held out in turn: the range margin, the relative widening of each class band ( [ 0.88 ​ min , 1.12 ​ max ] [0.88\min,\,1.12\max] at 0.12), becomes 0.50 instead of 0.12 (2 of 61 aircraft flagged, against 24 at 0.12); the equality factor, which multiplies the largest absolute log-residual of the clean records of each class for the identities A1, A5 and A6, becomes 1.25 instead of 1.15 (3 of 60, at the limit of the rule); and the mass-balance margin of A7, subtracted from the smallest clean mass-balance margin, stays at 0.05; with these values 5 of the 61 aircraft are flagged by some tolerance. This oracle flags 14 of the 46 clean test and out-of-distribution aircraft: 11 of the 16 in test, 10 of them narrowbodies on A1, whose class tolerance rests on 3 aircraft of 2 families, 3 business jets on A9, judged by the band fitted on all 61 aircraft, and none of the unseen families; its wider bands let the generator escalate further (median magnitude 0.8 against 0.4), and the benchmark holds 1,260 instances with 10 test controls. Retrained on its labels as above (Tables G.10 and G.11 ), NeSySpec on intervention labels keeps its false violations at the paper’s level on test (0.073 against 0.084, on par), with fewer on the unseen class (0.087 against 0.128), and its exact-set agreement on par on test and unseen families and slightly higher on the unseen class (0.206 against 0.155); its macro-F1 is lower on test (0.537 against 0.575) and unseen families (0.636 against 0.694), its abduction on test (0.491 against 0.593) and unseen families (0.508 against 0.594), and its key on the unseen class (0.735 against 0.778) and slightly on test (0.738 against 0.786), while detection is on par on test and unseen families and close on the unseen class (0.711 against 0.719). Against the comparators on intervention labels it stays ahead on every split of Fellegi-Holt and Z3 in diagnosis and of minimum-cardinality localization with random tie-break, ahead of the DL2-loss network in macro-F1 on unseen families, slightly on test ( + 0.037 +0.037 ) and on par on the unseen class, with the network keeping fewer false violations on test and the unseen class. In macro-F1 it is on par with the crisp edits on test and unseen families and slightly ahead on the unseen class ( + 0.029 +0.029 ), and, against the bands with a 25% margin, small classes pooled, that the validation rule of the crisp edits now selects (validation AUROC 0.943 against 0.942), on par on test and ahead on the other two splits. In abduction it is on par with the oracle tie-break on every split, and against the Class I residual on par on test, lower on unseen families ( − 0.096 -0.096 ) and ahead on the unseen class. On generator labels, with larger corruptions, NeSySpec reaches a detection AUROC of 0.976 on test, slightly below the residual MLP (0.994), and on the unseen class slightly below the residual MLP and TabPFN v2 (0.988 against 0.999 for both); its macro-F1 is on par with the DL2-loss network on test and the unseen class and ahead on unseen families, ahead of the crisp edits on test, slightly ahead on unseen families and below them on the unseen class; its key, 0.955 on test, is ahead of Fellegi-Holt on every split and of Z3 on test and unseen families, and on par with Z3 on the unseen class; abduction is on par with the oracle tie-break on every split and ahead of random tie-breaking; the repair lowers the error on the altered field on every split, reaches its target on 0.570 of single-field test records and changes 0.418 of the clean and control test records; and 109 of the 154 corrupted test records carry a violation their clean origin already has. Under these tolerances the bands widen, the training corruptions grow and training stops earlier (best epochs 15 to 27, against 80 to 100), so their effects on the key and abduction levels are not separated.
blocks.zh: 在61架清洁训练和验证飞机上,甲骨文按照在任何结果发生之前宣布的规则,将三种耐受性分别设定为最小值,当它们的家人被扣时,其旗帜最多为5%的清洁飞机的网格:射程比值,每类机段相对扩大([0.88分,1.12分最大][0.88/min,\,1.12分最大],0.12分),改为0.50分,而不是0.12分(61分机的2分,对0.12分),平等系数乘以A1、A5和A6分机的清洁记录的最大绝对值绝对值,成为1.25分,而不是1.15分(3分60分),在规则的限度内;从最小的清洁质量平衡比值中减去A7分,则停留在0.05分;61分机的这些值5分被某种容忍度标出。 46架清洁试验和分配外飞机中的这架甲骨文旗帜为14架:16架在试验中的11架,其中10架在A1上的窄体,其等级耐受性在于2个家庭的3架飞机上,A9上的3架商业喷气式飞机,由装在所有61架飞机上的波段判断,没有一架无人知晓的家庭;其较宽的波段让发电机进一步升级(中位数0.8比0.4),基准有1 260例测试控制。 如上(表G.10和G.11),NeSySpec在干预标签上对其标签进行再培训,使其虚假的违反行为保持在试纸水平(0.073对0.084,平方),在隐形等级上较少(0.087对0.128),在关于测试和隐形家庭的平价的精确协议,在隐形等级上稍高(0.206对0.15),其宏观F1在测试上较低(0.537对0.575),在隐形家庭的测试上较低(0.636对0.694)、在测试上绑架(0.491对0.593)和在隐形家庭的测试上(0.508对0.594),在隐形阶层上的钥匙(0.735对0.778对0.78)和在测试上略高(0.738对0.786),而在测试上检测上相等,在隐形阶层上较低(0.711对0.79)。 与干预标签的参照国相比,在Fellegi-Holt和Z3的诊断和最小心率局部化和随机断开带的情况下,在DL2-损失网络之前,在宏观F1的隐形家庭、略微测试(+ 0.037+ 0.037)和对等的隐形阶级上,都保持领先,网络在测试和隐形阶级上保存较少的虚假违规行为。 在宏F1中,在测试和未见家庭上,在测试和未见阶层上,在略高于前(+ 0.029+ 0.029),在比值为25%的频段上,小类集合,现在在测试和在其他两个分数上,简化编辑的验证规则(验证AUROC 0.943对0.942)是相同的。 在绑架时,它与神谕在每分一秒上断绝束缚,在试验时与I级残存者、在看不见的家庭(-0.096-0.096)和在看不见的阶层中前进者一样。 在发电机标签上,NeSySpec在测试时检测到0.976的AUROC,略低于残留的MLP(0.994),在未见的类别中略低于残留的MLP和TabPFN v2(0.988对0.999);其宏观-F1在测试时与DL2损失网络和未见的类别相当,在测试时与未见的类别和未见的家属比比,在测试时略提前,在未见的家属上比;其钥匙,即0.955在测试时比Fellegi-Holt领先,在测试和未见的家属上比Z3领先,在未见的类别上比Z3低;绑架与每次拆分和随机拆分解前的骨架断等同;每拆分时,被改变的场地的误差数低于0.570个单场测试记录,并更改了清洁和控制测试记录的0.418个目标;154个腐败的测试记录中已有违反清洁来源。 在这些容忍度下,乐队扩大,培训腐败加剧,培训更早停止(最佳纪元15至27,对80至100),因此对关键和绑架的影响没有分开。

blocks.en: Table G.10: Generator oracles: levels of NeSySpec and its comparators.
blocks.zh: 表G.10:发电机甲骨文:NeSySpec及其参照物的等级。

blocks.en: Oracle fitted on all 107 aircraft (the paper), on the 44 training aircraft with the paper’s tolerances, and on the 61 training and validation aircraft with tolerances chosen by leaving one family out (range margin 0.50, equality factor 1.25, mass-balance margin 0.05). Learned methods: means over 8 seeds. Intervention labels, set from the edit alone, are the same records under every oracle; generator labels differ between the three benchmarks. Constraint verdicts on generator labels: exact-set agreement / macro-F1 / false-violation rate. On intervention labels only NeSySpec and the DL2-loss network change; the crisp edits, Fellegi-Holt, Z3, minimum cardinality and the Class I residual are the same under every oracle, and since the oracle tie-break and the Class I residual reach the same intervention-label test level (0.453), their differences from NeSySpec coincide. Intervals of the intervention-label rows in Table G.11 ; those of the differences under the oracle on 107 aircraft in the DL2-loss macro-F1, the key and abduction are in Tables G.1 to G.4 and Appendix G.1 .

blocks.en: This appendix gives the results and the protocol of the comparison with explanation supervision summarized in Section . Under the protocol described at the end of this appendix, the grounding axiom localizes the annotated parts more than RRR [ 57 ] , GradMask [ 58 ] and Pukdee et al. [ 61 ] , with every cluster-bootstrap interval of the difference above zero on the FGVC pseudo-masks, on PASCAL-Part human masks (levels in Figure G.1 b) and on two further human-mask datasets. Against RRR, GradMask and Pukdee et al., in this order, its pointing exceeds theirs by + 0.725 +0.725 [ + 0.700 , + 0.750 ] [+0.700,\penalty\ +0.750] , + 0.779 +0.779 and + 0.618 +0.618 on the FGVC test pseudo-masks, by + 0.594 +0.594 [ + 0.559 , + 0.630 ] [+0.559,\penalty\ +0.630] , + 0.702 +0.702 and + 0.496 +0.496 on PASCAL-Part, by + 0.523 +0.523 [ + 0.475 , + 0.571 ] [+0.475,\penalty\ +0.571] , + 0.631 +0.631 and + 0.420 +0.420 on PartImageNet and by + 0.483 +0.483 [ + 0.359 , + 0.595 ] [+0.359,\penalty\ +0.595] , + 0.636 +0.636 and + 0.446 +0.446 on the 40 items of UDA-Part, with wider intervals on the last two; Pukdee et al. is run at the calibration of the protocol, which flattened their teacher toward the uniform prediction. The intervals of all 27 differences, nine mask configurations by three baselines, lie above zero, also under an independent bootstrap seed. Across the weights 0.3, 1 and 3 the axiom keeps at most one collapsed head, a head whose F1 is at most 0.05, against up to 5.7 on average for the auxiliary loss. At weight 1 it keeps an out-of-distribution accuracy lead of + 0.016 +0.016 [ + 0.012 , + 0.020 ] [+0.012,\penalty\ +0.020] over the auxiliary loss at its validation weight 0.3; test accuracy, by contrast, is degenerate (a constant predictor scores 0.926).

blocks.en: A first set of runs of RRR, GradMask, RES [ 59 ] (its RES-L variant, adapted to these part masks) and Pukdee et al. used λ = 1 \lambda=1 and penalties coupled across a batch through batch normalization [ 94 ] in training mode. The comparison retrains RRR, GradMask and Pukdee et al. with per-example penalties, the normalization constants held fixed, selects λ ∈ { 0.1 , 1 , 10 } \lambda\in\{0.1,1,10\} times a calibration constant on validation with one seed per value, and evaluates three seeds at the selected value. RES-L is not retrained: on these masks its adapted objective does not reward localization, so its pointing does not measure what RES can localize. A second arm of Pukdee et al., added after the results, measures its calibration constant at the first projection step instead of at initialization; it avoids the flattened teacher and weights the constraint about three orders of magnitude less. It points to the part in 0.179 of PASCAL-Part human masks, where the axiom’s lead over it is + 0.558 +0.558 [ + 0.524 , + 0.591 ] [+0.524,\penalty\ +0.591] , and the intervals of the axiom’s differences from it also lie above zero on the FGVC pseudo-masks and on every other human-mask set. Holding the normalization constants fixed makes each penalty per-example and leaves the network in inference mode unconstrained by it, a gap that a diagnostic measures for RRR.
blocks.zh: 第一套运行RR,GradMask,RES[59](其RES-L变体,适应这些部分口罩)和Pukdee等人. 使用==1\lambda=1 并在培训模式下,通过批量正常化进行分批处罚。 比较RRR,GradMask和Pukdee等人与每个例罚,常态常数固定,选择QQ {{{0.1,1,10}\lambda\in}{0.1,1,10\}乘以每个值一个种子的校准常数,按选定的值评价三个种子. RES-L没有再训练:在这些口罩上,其改造后的目标不能奖励本地化,因此其指针不能衡量RES能本地化的内容. 在结果之后添加的Pukdee等人的第二臂,在第一投影步骤而不是初始化时测量其校准常数;它避免了扁平的老师,把约束量压在大约三个数量级上. 它指出了PASCAL-Part人体口罩中0.179的部分,其中轴对它的领先是+0.558+0.558[+0.524,+0.591][+0.524,\penalty\+0.591],轴对它的区别的间隔也位于FGVC假面板和所有其他人类面具组上高于零. 持有正常化常数可以使每个罚则逐例增加,使网络推论模式不受其约束,这是RRR的一个诊断措施.
